# hazy

Turborepo for **hazy** and **hazy-note** — two views of one product, one Clerk
tenant, one database.

| | |
|---|---|
| `apps/hazy` | Save URLs, search your reading, ask questions about it, read-later digest. Next 16, next-intl (en/ja). |
| `apps/hazy-note` | Turn saved URLs into your own writing: capture → organise → notes → compare → graph → export. Next 15. |
| `packages/db` | `@repo/db` — the single Drizzle schema + client + migrations + search-vector trigger. See `packages/db/README.md`. |

Both apps resolve the signed-in Clerk user to a `users` row by `clerk_id`; same
Clerk instance → same `users.id` → `saved_urls` / `collections` are shared. A URL
saved in hazy shows up in hazy-note's library and vice versa.

## Getting started

```bash
bun install
# packages/db/.env.local + apps/*/.env.local — DATABASE_URL, Clerk, OpenRouter
bun run dev            # turbo: hazy-note on :3000, hazy on :3100
```

Local Postgres for development: `apps/hazy-note/scripts/localdb.sh start`
(user-owned PG on `127.0.0.1:5433`, no Docker). Then, from `packages/db/`:
`bun db:push && bun db:trigger`.

## Tasks (`bun run <task>` at the root → `turbo run`)

| Task | |
|---|---|
| `dev` | Both dev servers (`--filter=hazy` / `--filter=hazy-note` for one) |
| `build` | `next build` for both |
| `lint` | Biome |
| `check-types` | `tsc --noEmit` across all three packages |
| `db:generate` / `db:migrate` / `db:push` / `db:trigger` / `db:studio` | `@repo/db`, driven by `packages/db/.env.local` |
| `cf:build` / `cf:deploy` / `cf:preview` | Per app — OpenNext → Cloudflare Workers |

## Deploy

Each app is its **own Cloudflare Worker** (`apps/*/wrangler.jsonc`,
`open-next.config.ts`). Both use `@repo/db`'s Neon HTTP driver on the Worker
runtime (no raw TCP sockets there). Locally, a `127.0.0.1` `DATABASE_URL`
transparently switches to the postgres.js TCP driver instead.

Deploy one: `bun run cf:deploy --filter=hazy` (needs `wrangler login` +
`apps/hazy/.dev.vars` for `cf:preview`). Or point Cloudflare Workers Builds at
each app dir with build `bunx turbo run cf:build --filter=<app>`.

through `turbo` from the root (`bun run dev`, `bun run check-types`, …); add
`--filter=hazy` to scope to this app. One `bun.lock` at the repo root.

content.text:
Turborepo migration complete. All changes are **staged, not committed** (branch `dev`, HEAD unchanged) — review and commit when ready.

## Structure

```
hazy-repo/                    ← git root now (was hazy/.git)
  package.json  turbo.json  tsconfig.base.json  bunfig.toml  bun.lock
  apps/hazy/                  ← git mv, history preserved (Next 16, next-intl, Cloudflare)
  apps/hazy-note/             ← new to git    (Next 15, Cloudflare added)
  packages/db/                ← @repo/db — the one Drizzle schema + client + migrations
```

- **Package manager:** bun workspaces, one root `bun.lock`. `bunfig.toml` pins `linker = "hoisted"` — bun's default isolated `.bun/` store breaks OpenNext's esbuild resolution (`postgres` from `drizzle-orm/postgres-js`).
- **Deploy:** unchanged intent — each app is its **own Cloudflare Worker**. hazy-note gained `wrangler.jsonc` / `open-next.config.ts` / OpenNext deps.

## `@repo/db` (ends the hand-synced schema)

- `src/schema.ts` — canonical schema (hazy's camelCase + `Date` style). hazy-note's `repo.ts` / `current-user.ts` / `seed.ts` rewritten to it (~200 mechanical renames, tsc-verified).
- `src/client.ts` — `getDb(url?)`: postgres.js for `localhost`, Neon HTTP otherwise (the Workers-compatible path). **hazy-note dropped `pg`** — it can't run on Workers.
- `migrations/` moved here; `apps/hazy/src/db/schema.ts` is now `export * from "@repo/db/schema"` so hazy's ~40 db files are untouched.
- New migration **`0004`** — canonicalises the `collection_items` unique-constraint column order (drizzle-kit introspection had emitted it reversed). Safe no-op; applied to the local DB.

## Verified

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `bun run check-types` | ✅ 3 packages |
| `bun run lint` | ✅ (both apps on Biome; hazy-note's `next lint` was deprecated/broken) |
| `bun run db:generate` | ✅ "No schema changes" |
| `bun run dev` | ✅ hazy-note :3000, hazy :3100 |
| `bun run build` | ✅ both |
| `bun run cf:build --filter=hazy` / `--filter=hazy-note` | ✅ Workers bundles **1.97 / 1.05 MiB gzipped** (limit 3) |
| Data linkage | ✅ both apps' DB layers return the same rows against the shared DB |

## Also fixed along the way (pre-existing, blocked the build)

- `apps/hazy-note/app/(app)/export/` — `useSearchParams` not in a Suspense boundary → split into `page.tsx` + `export-client.tsx` (matches `/capture`).
- `apps/hazy`'s `next` was pinned `15.5.23` in package.json but running 16.3.0 → pinned to `16.3.0`; added `@clerk/backend` explicit dep (workspace hoisting hid the transitive one).

## Not done (out of scope / needs you)

- **No commit** — 242 staged paths. `git status` shows the renames.
- `opennextjs-cloudflare preview` / actual deploy — needs `wrangler login` + `apps/*/.dev.vars` (examples added).
- The `packages/db/README.md` covers migrations/rollback; `apps/hazy-note/docs/shared-database.md` was removed (superseded).
- 31 Biome **warnings** remain in hazy-note UI (a11y `type="button"`, array-index keys) — downgraded to warn, not errors.

content.text:
hazy-note の `/export`（書き出す）を、モックから実際に動く機能にしました。

## 改善内容

**これまで:** 「Markdown」ボタンは何もせず、「書き出す」は偽のトースト（`社内共有 (clipboard)` 等の文字列）を出すだけ。「出典表を付ける」ラジオは無反応。

**いま:**

| 要素 | 動作 |
|---|---|
| **Markdown** ボタン | 下書きを Markdown 化して `<タイトル>.md` をダウンロード |
| **コピー**（新規） | 同じ Markdown をクリップボードへ |
| **書き出す** | 形式で分岐 — `社内共有メモ` → クリップボード、`ブログ記事`/`要点だけ` → `.md` ダウンロード。サーバー往復（＝毎回 LLM 再生成）を廃止し、表示中の下書きから生成 |
| **出典表を付ける**（list / footnote / none） | ノートの `sources` を Markdown 末尾に反映。`末尾にリンク一覧` → `## 出典` の番号付きリスト、`脚注` → `[^n]: label` 定義。プレビューにも即反映 |

- Markdown 生成: `# タイトル` / `## 見出し` / `> ⚠️ 注記` / 段落、`\n{3,}` 圧縮
- 出典がないノートでは注記を表示
- 右下の説明文が現在の形式で何が起きるか明示

## ついでに直したバグ（書き出しの導線上）

`buildExport` / `getNote` / `getItem` に **UUID ガード**を追加。ノート未選択（`noteId=""`）や不正 ID で `/api/export` が `invalid input syntax for type uuid` の 500 を返していた（`saved_urls` の pg ドライバ時代からの潜在バグ）。今は「書き出すノートがありません」のプレースホルダを正常に返します。

content.text:
ノート機能を、**読むだけ + 末尾追記のみ**から、実際に編集できるエディタにしました。バックエンド（`PATCH /api/notes/[id]` + `updateNote`）は元々フル編集対応済みで、UI が使っていなかっただけです。

## エディタ (`/notes/[id]`)

| 機能 | 動作 |
|---|---|
| **段落の編集** | 段落にホバー → 鉛筆ハンドル → インラインで textarea 編集。blur / ⌘+Enter で保存、Esc で取消、空にすると削除 |
| **ブロック削除** | 段落・引用・ハイライトにホバー → × ハンドル |
| **タグ編集** | タグをクリックで外す、「+ タグ」で追加。ノートに保存 |
| **状態の切替** | タイトル横に 下書き ⇄ 完了 のチップ |
| **保存インジケータ** | 書き込み中は「保存中…」、完了後「自動保存 · たった今」 |

- 動かないモック UI を撤去：「選択範囲に 出典を探す / 疑問として切り出す / 短くする」ツールバーと「言い換える」ボタン（どれも未実装だった）
- 空の状態表示（状態・出典パネル）、「つながるノート」は空なら非表示
- 引用アイコン `youtube-logo` → `quotes`

## 一覧 (`/notes`)

- カードごとに状態アイコン（完了＝アクセントのチェック / 下書き＝破線の丸）
- メタ表示「N段落 · M出典」

## ついでの堅牢化

`getNote` / `getNoteRow` / `getItem` に UUID ガード追加（書き出しのバグと同種 — 空・不正 ID が Postgres の `::uuid` キャストで 500 になっていた）。

## 検証

- E2E（repo 経由）: 作成 → 追記 → ブロック編集 → タグ設定 → 状態 done → ブロック削除、すべて永続化・`updatedLabel` 更新を確認
- `bunx turbo run check-types lint` 全パス
- dev サーバー稼働中・反映済み（あなたが今開いているノート `70ed6482…` でそのまま使えます）

content.text:
原因は **段落の操作ハンドル（鉛筆・ゴミ箱）が画面外に配置されていた**ことでした。前回追加した `BlockHandles` を `absolute -left-[52px]`（段落の左外側）に置いていたため、`main` の左パディング44px と相殺して x≈-8px となり、ビューポート左端で見切れて**クリックできない**状態でした。段落が1つでも起きますが、複数段落で「前の段落を直したい」ときに気づく形になっていました。

## 修正

| 内容 | |
|---|---|
| ハンドル位置 | `-left-[52px]`（左外・見切れ）→ **`right-1 top-1`（各ブロック右上・内側）**、背景付きでホバー表示。どの画面幅でも届く |
| アイコン | 削除を `x` → `trash` に |
| 書き込みの直列化 | 段落追加・編集・削除・タグ・状態変更を `write()` で1件ずつ実行（重なると `blocks` 配列まるごと置換のため lost-update が起きうる）。実行中は「保存中…」表示で新規操作をブロック |
| 堅牢化 | `editBlockText` で `current` が `undefined`（削除との競合）でも落ちないようガード。空にしたら段落削除 |

## 検証

- バックエンド E2E: 3回追記 → **ブロック0を編集** → **ブロック0を削除**、すべて正常（＝バグは完全にフロント側の配置問題）
- `bunx turbo run check-types lint` 全パス
- dev サーバー稼働・反映済み（開いているノートでホバーすると右上にハンドルが出ます）

ノートのリンクをメニューの一番上にしてプライマリーカラーで目立つように
ノートを主要機能にしたい
また編集時はクリックだけで編集可能状態にしたい

## 新規 `components/loading.tsx`

| コンポーネント | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `<Spinner>` | 回転リング（インライン・ボタン用） |
| `<Loading label>` | 全画面：アクセントの「霧」ドット（取り込みフローと同じ）＋ラベル |
| `<SkeletonLines lines>` | シマーする本文プレースホルダ |
| `<SkeletonCards count>` | シマーするカードグリッド（ノート／受信箱のレイアウトに一致） |

## 適用箇所

| 画面 | Before → After |
|---|---|
| **ルート `loading.tsx`** | `/notes`（スケルトンカード）・`/notes/[id]`（霧ドット）を新設 — 遷移した瞬間に表示 |
| `/notes` 一覧 | 空状態がチラ見え → **スケルトンカード6枚** |
| `/notes/[id]` 編集 | 「読み込み中…」テキスト → 霧ドット。「保存中…」にスピナー追加 |
| `/compare` `/graph` | テキスト → 霧ドット（「比較ボードを読み込んでいます」「つながりを組み立てています」） |
| `/export` | 「下書きを生成しています…」テキスト → スピナー＋スケルトン行 |
| Suspense fallback（`/library` `/capture` `/export`） | ベアテキスト → `<Loading />` |

新規ノートは、**最初の編集があるまで DB に書き込まない**ようにしました。

## 仕組み

「新しいノート」/「＋」→ `api.addNote()` で即 INSERT していたのを、`/notes/new` への遷移に変更。

- **`/notes/new`** — 空のノートをメモリ内で保持（`BLANK`、fetch なし）。離脱しても DB には何も残らない
- **最初の実編集**（段落追加・段落編集・タグ追加・状態変更・改名）で初めて `POST /api/notes` — その1件だけ、編集内容込みで作成。URL を `history.replaceState` で `/notes/<id>` に差し替え（画面遷移なし・フォーカス維持）
- 以降は通常の PATCH

## 変更ファイル

| ファイル | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `lib/db/repo.ts` `createNote` | `blocks` / `tags` / `status` を受け取れるように（初回編集を1リクエストで反映） |
| `app/api/notes/route.ts` | 同上をパース |
| `lib/api.ts` `addNote` | 型を拡張 |
| `app/(app)/notes/[id]/note-client.tsx` | `id` を optional に。draft 判定、全編集を「次の Note を計算 → `persist()`」に統一（`persist` が id 有無で PATCH / 新規作成を振り分け）。draft 中は「書き出す」「下書きを起こす」を非表示、削除ボタンは「破棄」表示 |
| `app/(app)/notes/new/page.tsx` `loading.tsx` | 新設 |
| `app/(app)/notes/page.tsx` / `components/sidebar.tsx` | 作成ボタンを `/notes/new` へのリンクに |

## 検証

- `createNote` に `blocks`/`tags`/`status` を渡して作成 → OK
- `bunx turbo run check-types lint` 全パス、dev コンパイルクリーン

ノートの「つづきを書く」欄で **`@` によるURL引用**と**予測変換リスト**を実装しました。

## 動作

1. `つづきを書く` 欄で **`@`** を打つと、その場で**保存済みURLの候補リスト**がポップアップ（`api.items()` の `saved_urls`、メモ除く）
2. `@` の後ろに文字を打つと**タイトル・サイト・URLで絞り込み**（予測変換）
3. **↑↓で選択、Enter / Tab で確定、Esc で閉じる**、クリックでも選択
4. 確定すると本文に **`[n]`** が挿入され、そのURLがノートの**出典** (`note.sources`) に `{ n, label: "タイトル — サイト", cited: true }` として登録 → サイドバー「このノートの出典」に即反映
5. 同じURLを再度引用すると同じ番号を再利用

## 変更

| ファイル | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `components/cite-box.tsx` | 新規。自動リサイズ textarea ＋ `@` メンションのドロップダウン。Enter で `onSubmit`（段落追加）、`@` 中は候補選択に切替 |
| `note-client.tsx` | append 欄を `<CiteBox>` に。`cite(label,url)` で出典登録＋番号返却。編集処理を **ref ベースの直列キュー**（`enqueue` / `mutate`）に作り直し — 連続編集でも取りこぼし・レース・stale 上書きが起きない。書き込み失敗でキューが止まらない |
| `lib/db/repo.ts` `updateNote` / `createNote` | `sources` を受け取れるように |
| `app/api/notes/route.ts` / `[id]/route.ts` | `sources` をパース |
| `lib/api.ts` `addNote` | 型拡張 |

## 検証

- `createNote` / `updateNote` で `sources` の保存・読み戻しを確認（`[1] lat.md`, `[2] Chat SDK` …）
- `bunx turbo run check-types lint` 全 5 タスクパス、dev コンパイルクリーン

content.text:
原因は `CiteBox` の `@` 検出のバグでした。`@` を打っても候補リストが開かない状態だったので「うごかない」ように見えていました。

## 何が起きていたか

`@token` を検出する `scan()` が **`value` プロップ**（親から渡る値、キー入力より1レンダー遅れる）を読み、しかも `requestAnimationFrame` 経由で**古いクロージャ**が実行されていました。→ `@` を打った瞬間の `scan` はまだ `@` を含まない文字列を見る → 正規表現が一致しない → ドロップダウンが永久に開かない。

## 修正（`components/cite-box.tsx`）

| 変更 | |
|---|---|
| `scan()` / `pick()` | `value` プロップではなく **`textarea` の実 DOM 値**（`ref.current.value`）を読む。常に最新 |
| 呼び出し | `onChange` から rAF を挟まず**同期実行** |
| 正規表現 | `/@([^\s@[\]]*)$/` — カーソル手前の **`@` があれば即トリガー**（前が空白でなくてOK、文中・日本語の後でも動く） |
| 追加 | Backspace/Delete でも再スキャン、`results[sel]` ガード、候補8件 |

バックエンド（`sources` の保存・読み戻し）は前回確認済みで問題なし。

`bunx turbo run check-types lint` パス、dev コンパイル済み。**ブラウザをハードリロード**すれば新しいバンドルで動きます（`つづきを書く` 欄で `@` → 候補 → ↑↓/Enter/クリックで確定、本文に `[n]`、サイドバー「このノートの出典」に反映）。

※まだコミットはしていません。確認できたら言ってください。
@での引用時に確定したらリンクのタイトル文字とクリックしたら新規タブで遷移機能を追加

一連の作業が完了しました。`bunx turbo run check-types lint build` 全7タスクパス、dev サーバー稼働中（:3000 / :3100、ともに Next 16 Turbopack）。

## `@` 引用のリンク化

| 変更 | |
|---|---|
| 確定時の挿入 | `[n]` → **`[タイトル](URL)`**（Markdown リンク記法） |
| `RichText` コンポーネント | `[text](url)` を `<a target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">` に描画。リンククリックで新規タブ、段落編集は発火しない（`stopPropagation`） |
| 適用箇所 | 段落・引用ブロックの表示 |
| 出典データ | `NoteSourceRef` / schema jsonb に `url?` 追加、`cite` が保存。サイドバー「このノートの出典」も新規タブで開くリンクに |

## `@` ピッカーが動かなかったバグ

`scan()` が `value` プロップ（1レンダー遅れ）を rAF 経由の古いクロージャで読んでいた → **実 DOM 値を同期で読む**ように修正。

## ultrareview の指摘対応（3件）

- **bug_002**：正規表現から `(?:^|\s)` 境界を外していた → メールや `@decorator` が Enter を乗っ取り本文破壊。境界を復元し、`pick` も `scan` と同じ正規表現で `@` 位置を特定
- **bug_001**：`url?` の配線未完（`void url`）→ 上記のリンク機能で完了
- **bug_003**：onKeyUp の Backspace/Delete は onChange と重複 → 削除

## Turbopack + bun

- **hazy-note を Next 15.5.24 → 16.3.0**（hazy と統一、React 19.2.8 ピン）
- 両アプリ `dev`/`build` に `--turbopack` 明示
- **ランタイム**：`bun --bun next` は `serverExternalPackages`（Turbopack + `@repo/db` ワークスペース）で壊れるため Next は Node で実行。bun はツールチェーンとして統一（`bun install`、`bun run`、`db:trigger` を `tsx`→`bun` に、tsx 依存削除）
- **surfaced した実バグを修正**：`serverExternalPackages` + Turbopack dev + `@repo/db` → 全 DB ルートが `Failed to load external module drizzle-orm-<hash>` で 500。**フェーズ条件分岐**（本番/Worker ビルドのみ externalize、dev は空）で解決
- `cf:build` 両アプリ検証済み → Worker 1.97 / 1.21 MiB gzip（3 MiB 制限内）

## 1. Route handlers under `apps/hazy-note/app/api/**`

Every file: `export const dynamic = "force-dynamic"`, **no `runtime` export** (default Node; on deploy everything runs inside the single OpenNext Worker). Every handler calls `requireAppUser()` first, then a `lib/db/repo` function, then `NextResponse.json(...)`. **No handler imports `lib/ai` or `lib/extract` directly** — AI/extraction is reached only transitively through `repo.ts`. Body parsing is always `await req.json().catch(() => ({}))` followed by ad-hoc `typeof` / `Array.isArray` guards. No Zod, no shared wrapper.

| Route (file) | Methods | Purpose | `repo.ts` fns used | Body / input validation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `app/api/compare/route.ts` | GET, POST | GET current compare board (or `EMPTY` const); POST re-synthesise board for a project | `getCompare`, `buildCompareBoard` | POST: `projectId` kept only if `typeof === "string"` |
| `app/api/digest/route.ts` | GET | Dashboard "未整理" digest counts + message | `getDigest` | none |
| `app/api/export/route.ts` | GET, POST | GET export draft from `?noteId=&format=`; POST same draft + `exportedTo` string | `buildExport` | `format` checked against `["blog","memo","bullets"]`; `noteId` coerced to string, `""` fallback |
| `app/api/graph/route.ts` | GET, POST | GET cached graph snapshot (builds if none); POST recompute | `getGraph`, `buildGraph` | none |
| `app/api/items/[id]/read/route.ts` | POST | Run the "読み取り" pipeline (fetch → extract → summarise) | `finishReading` | none; 404 if item missing |
| `app/api/items/[id]/route.ts` | GET, PATCH, DELETE | Get / patch / delete one saved item | `getItem`, `updateItem`, `deleteItem` | PATCH: **raw parsed body passed straight to `updateItem`** (field filtering happens in repo) |
| `app/api/items/importable/route.ts` | GET | hazy `saved_urls` not yet worked — the "Hazyから追加" picker | `listImportable` | none |
| `app/api/items/route.ts` | GET, POST | List items; POST add a URL (`{url}`) or a pasted memo (`{text}`) | `listItems`, `addItem`, `addMemo` | `url`/`text` string-trimmed; 400 `{error:"url or text is required"}` if neither; 201 on success |
| `app/api/items/sort/route.ts` | POST | "まとめて振り分け" — move tagged unsorted items into accent collection | `autoSort` | none |
| `app/api/notes/[id]/route.ts` | GET, PATCH, DELETE | Get / update / delete a note. PATCH branches: `{text}` alone → append paragraph; else field patch | `getNote`, `updateNote`, `deleteNote`, `appendParagraph` | per-field `typeof`/`Array.isArray`; `status` ∈ `{draft,done}`; 400 if append text empty |
| `app/api/notes/[id]/suggestion/route.ts` | POST | Accept / dismiss an inline AI suggestion block | `acceptSuggestion`, `dismissSuggestion` | `blockIndex` must be integer, `action` ∈ `{accept,dismiss}`, else 400 |
| `app/api/notes/route.ts` | GET, POST | List / create notes | `listNotes`, `createNote` | per-field `typeof`/`Array.isArray`; 201 on create |
| `app/api/projects/[id]/route.ts` | PATCH, DELETE | Rename / re-tone / delete a collection | `updateProject`, `deleteProject` | `name` string, `tone` ∈ `{accent,neutral}` |
| `app/api/projects/route.ts` | GET, POST | List / create collections | `listProjects`, `createProject` | `name` required → 400 `{error:"name is required"}`; `tone` defaults `neutral`; 201 |
| `app/api/tags/route.ts` | GET | Tag list with usage counts (raw SQL `unnest(tags)`) | `listTags` | none |

---

## 2. Data-access layer

### `apps/hazy-note/lib/db/repo.ts`

Imports AI from `@/lib/ai` (`rewriteForExport`, `suggestConnections`, `summariseMemo`, `summariseSource`, `synthesiseCompare`) and `fetchAndExtract` from `@/lib/extract`; DB from `./index`. Every exported fn takes `userId: string` first and scopes all queries by it. Helpers `relativeLabel`, `kindFromUrl`, `siteFromUrl`, `normalizeUrl`, `toItem`, `toNote`, `toCompare`, `ringLayout`, `isUuid` are module-private.

Exported signatures (verbatim):

```ts
// Items
export async function listItems(userId: string): Promise<Item[]>
export async function listImportable(userId: string): Promise<Item[]>
export async function getItem(userId: string, id: string): Promise<Item | undefined>
export async function addItem(userId: string, url: string): Promise<Item>
export async function addMemo(userId: string, text: string): Promise<Item>
export async function finishReading(userId: string, id: string): Promise<Item | undefined>
export async function updateItem(
  userId: string, id: string,
  patch: Partial<Pick<Item, "tags" | "projectId" | "title" | "summary">>
): Promise<Item | undefined>
export async function deleteItem(userId: string, id: string): Promise<boolean>
export async function autoSort(userId: string): Promise<{ moved: number }>

// Projects & Tags
export async function listProjects(userId: string): Promise<Project[]>
export async function createProject(
  userId: string, name: string, tone: "accent" | "neutral" = "neutral"
): Promise<Project>
export async function updateProject(
  userId: string, id: string, patch: { name?: string; tone?: "accent" | "neutral" }
): Promise<Project | undefined>
export async function deleteProject(userId: string, id: string): Promise<boolean>
export async function listTags(userId: string): Promise<Tag[]>
export async function getDigest(userId: string): Promise<Digest>

// Notes
export async function listNotes(userId: string): Promise<Note[]>
export async function createNote(
  userId: string,
  input: {
    title?: string; projectId?: string | null; text?: string;
    blocks?: NoteBlock[]; tags?: Note["tags"]; status?: Note["status"];
    sources?: Note["sources"];
  } = {}
): Promise<Note>
export async function updateNote(
  userId: string, id: string,
  patch: Partial<Pick<Note, "title" | "status" | "projectId" | "blocks" | "tags" | "sources">>
): Promise<Note | undefined>
export async function deleteNote(userId: string, id: string): Promise<boolean>
export async function getNote(userId: string, id: string): Promise<Note | undefined>
export async function acceptSuggestion(userId: string, noteId: string, blockIndex: number): Promise<Note | undefined>
export async function dismissSuggestion(userId: string, noteId: string, blockIndex: number): Promise<Note | undefined>
export async function appendParagraph(userId: string, noteId: string, text: string): Promise<Note | undefined>

// Compare
export async function getCompare(userId: string): Promise<CompareBoard | undefined>
export async function buildCompareBoard(userId: string, projectId?: string): Promise<CompareBoard>

// Graph
export async function buildGraph(userId: string): Promise<GraphData>
export async function getGraph(userId: string): Promise<GraphData>

// Export
export async function buildExport(
  userId: string, noteId: string, format: ExportFormat = "blog"
): Promise<ExportDraft>
```

Notable behaviours: `addItem` upserts on `(userId, normalizedUrl)`; `addMemo` writes `kind:"note"` with a synthetic `hazy:memo:<uuid>` URL and raw text in `extractedText`. `finishReading` is best-effort — a fetch/AI failure sets `fetchStatus:"error"` and still resolves. `buildGraph`/`buildCompareBoard`/`buildExport` all call the LLM. `listTags` uses `db.execute(sql\`…\`)` and manually normalises postgres.js-array vs neon-http-`{rows}` result shapes. Tables referenced: `savedUrls`, `collectionItems`, `collections`, `notes`, `compareBoards`, `graphSnapshots` (all from `@repo/db`).

### `apps/hazy-note/lib/db/current-user.ts` — `requireAppUser()`

```ts
export async function requireAppUser() {
  const { userId: clerkId } = await auth();               // @clerk/nextjs/server
  if (!clerkId) { const err = new Error("unauthenticated"); err.name = "Unauthenticated"; throw err; }
  const existing = await db.query.users.findFirst({ where: (u,{eq}) => eq(u.clerkId, clerkId) });
  if (existing) return existing;
  const cu = await currentUser();
  const [created] = await db.insert(schema.users).values({
    clerkId, email: cu?.emailAddresses[0]?.emailAddress,
    displayName: cu?.fullName || cu?.username || undefined, avatarUrl: cu?.imageUrl,
  }).onConflictDoUpdate({ target: schema.users.clerkId, set: { updatedAt: new Date() } }).returning();
  await seedForUser(created.id);
  return created;
}
```

Returns the internal `users` row (Drizzle `$inferSelect`). Lazily creates + seeds the user on first sight. The thrown `Unauthenticated` error is **not caught by any route** — it would surface as a 500, but `middleware.ts` already blocks unauthenticated requests so it is effectively unreachable in prod.

### `apps/hazy-note/lib/db/index.ts`

```ts
import { getDb } from "@repo/db/client";
import * as schema from "@repo/db/schema";
export const db = getDb();
export { schema };
```

`getDb()` (in `packages/db/src/client.ts`) is lazy + self-caching and picks the driver from the URL: `postgres.js` (raw TCP) for `localhost`/`127.0.0.1`/`::1`, otherwise `@neondatabase/serverless` neon-http (the branch that works on Workers). Throws if `DATABASE_URL` unset.

### `apps/hazy-note/lib/db/seed.ts` — `seedForUser(userId)`

Idempotent (returns early if the user already has a collection). Inserts two default collections: `いま気になっていること` (`tone:"accent"` — the auto-sort / digest target) and `あとで読む` (`tone:"neutral"`). No demo content.

---

## 3. `apps/hazy-note/lib/api.ts` — client fetch wrapper

`"use client"`-only consumer. Helper `j<T>()` throws `Error(\`${status} ${statusText}\`)` on `!res.ok`; `opts()` sets JSON content-type + `cache:"no-store"`. Single exported `const api` object:

```ts
digest()                        -> GET  /api/digest
items()                         -> GET  /api/items
importable()                    -> GET  /api/items/importable
item(id)                        -> GET  /api/items/:id
addItem(url)                    -> POST /api/items            {url}
addMemo(text)                   -> POST /api/items            {text}
finishReading(id)               -> POST /api/items/:id/read
updateItem(id, patch)           -> PATCH /api/items/:id       Partial<Item>
deleteItem(id)                  -> DELETE /api/items/:id
autoSort()                      -> POST /api/items/sort
projects()                      -> GET  /api/projects
addProject(name, tone="neutral")-> POST /api/projects         {name, tone}
updateProject(id, patch)        -> PATCH /api/projects/:id     {name?, tone?}
deleteProject(id)               -> DELETE /api/projects/:id
tags()                          -> GET  /api/tags
notes()                         -> GET  /api/notes
note(id)                        -> GET  /api/notes/:id
addNote(input={})               -> POST /api/notes            {title?,projectId?,text?,blocks?,tags?,status?,sources?}
updateNote(id, patch)           -> PATCH /api/notes/:id        Partial<Note>
deleteNote(id)                  -> DELETE /api/notes/:id
appendParagraph(id, text)       -> PATCH /api/notes/:id        {text}
suggestion(id, blockIndex, action) -> POST /api/notes/:id/suggestion {blockIndex, action}
compare()                       -> GET  /api/compare
rebuildCompare(projectId?)      -> POST /api/compare          {projectId?}
graph()                         -> GET  /api/graph
rebuildGraph()                  -> POST /api/graph
export(noteId, format)          -> GET  /api/export?noteId=&format=
runExport(noteId, format)       -> POST /api/export           {noteId, format}
```

**Call sites (all client components):**
- `app/(app)/graph/page.tsx` — `api.graph`, `api.rebuildGraph`
- `app/(app)/compare/page.tsx` — `api.compare`, `api.projects`, `api.rebuildCompare`, `api.addNote`
- `app/(app)/notes/page.tsx` — `api.notes`
- `app/(app)/notes/[id]/note-client.tsx` — `api.note`, `api.updateNote`, `api.addNote`, `api.suggestion`, `api.deleteNote`
- `app/(app)/library/library-client.tsx` — `api.addItem`, `api.deleteItem` (plus more)
- `app/(app)/capture/capture-client.tsx` — `api.projects`, `api.item`, `api.finishReading`, `api.importable`, `api.addItem`, `api.updateItem`
- `app/(app)/export/export-client.tsx` — `api.notes` (plus export calls)
- `components/sidebar.tsx` — `api.autoSort`, `api.addProject`
- `components/cite-box.tsx` — `api.items`

**Does the frontend ever call `repo.ts` directly from server components? No.** `grep` for `@/lib/db/repo` and `requireAppUser` outside `app/api/**` returns nothing. Every page under `app/(app)/` is either `"use client"` (notes list, compare, graph) or a trivial server wrapper that renders a `Suspense` + client component (`library`, `capture`, `export`, `notes/[id]`, `notes/new`). `app/(app)/page.tsx` just `redirect("/notes")`; `app/(app)/layout.tsx` only renders `<Sidebar/>`. `app/layout.tsx` only wires `ClerkProvider` + fonts. So the data path is strictly **client component → `lib/api` → `/api/*` route → `repo.ts` → `@repo/db`**. There is no server-side data fetching, no RSC DB access, no server actions.

---

## 4. AI / extraction

### `apps/hazy-note/lib/llm.ts` — OpenRouter client

- `ENDPOINT = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions"`.
- Env: `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` (required for any AI), `OPENROUTER_MODEL_ID` (default `mistralai/mistral-small-2603`), `OPENROUTER_SITE_URL` (→ `HTTP-Referer`, default `http://localhost:3000`), `OPENROUTER_APP_NAME` (→ `X-Title`, default `Hazy`).
- `llmConfigured()` = `!!process.env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY`.
- `class LLMError extends Error`.
- `chat(messages, opts)` — single completion via `fetch` POST, `AbortController` 30 s timeout, `temperature` 0.4, `max_tokens` 1200, optional `response_format:{type:"json_object"}`. Throws `LLMError` on request failure / non-2xx / empty completion.
- `chatJSON<T>()` — calls `chat` with `json:true`, strips ```` ```json ```` fences, tries `JSON.parse`, then a bracket-substring fallback, else throws `LLMError`.

### `apps/hazy-note/lib/ai.ts` — task wrappers

Each returns strict-JSON parsed output, and on missing key **or** `LLMError` returns a deterministic stand-in built by `sentences()` (regex sentence split) / `arr()` coercion. **Non-`LLMError` exceptions are re-thrown.** Functions:
- `summariseSource({title,text,kind})` → `SourceDigest {title?, summary[3], points[≤3], suggestedTags[≤5]}`; fallback = first 3/2 sentences, empty tags. Skips LLM if text < 40 chars.
- `summariseMemo(text)` → same shape; skips LLM if < 30 chars.
- `synthesiseCompare(sources[])` → `{axes, summary, candidateAxes}`; needs ≥2 sources else canned message (mentions `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` when unconfigured).
- `suggestConnections(nodes[])` → `{from,to,reason}[]` (≤5), filtered to known ids; `[]` fallback.
- `rewriteForExport({title,blocks,format})` → `{title,blocks,provenance,warning}`; `passthrough` fallback keeps only `p` blocks. Format-specific prompt for `bullets`/`memo`/`blog`.

### `apps/hazy-note/lib/extract.ts` — `fetchAndExtract(url)`

Dependency-free. `fetch` with `AbortController` 15 s timeout, custom UA `HazyNoteBot/1.0`, `redirect:"follow"`. Non-HTML/XML content-type → returns `{text:"", title:undefined}` (PDF/JS pages). HTML capped at 2 MB; regex extraction of `og:title`/`twitter:title`/`<title>`, `og:description`/`meta description`, `og:image`, favicon (`rel=…icon` or `/favicon.ico`), `<html lang>`. `htmlToText()` grabs `<article>`/`<main>` if present, strips script/style/nav/header/footer/aside/form/comments, converts block tags to newlines, decodes entities, caps at 12 000 chars. `readMinutes` = words/450. **Throws** on network error or non-2xx.

### External deps / Node-only APIs

- No npm deps in any of these files — only global `fetch`, `AbortController`, `setTimeout`, `URL`, `crypto.randomUUID()` (in `repo.ts` `addMemo`). All are available in `workerd` with `nodejs_compat`.
- No `fs`, no `cheerio`/`jsdom`/`@mozilla/readability`, no `node:*` imports anywhere in `lib/` except `next.config.ts` (`node:path`, `node:url` — build-time only).
- `lib/ai.ts` docstring is stale ("mock summary" / "canned draft" comments in routes) — the implementation is real.
- No `lib/ai/*` directory and no `lib/extract*` beyond the single files — the plural in the request maps to `lib/ai.ts` + `lib/llm.ts` + `lib/extract.ts`.

---

## 5. Error handling

**No shared wrapper.** Every route hand-rolls `NextResponse.json(...)`. Contrast with `apps/hazy/src/lib/api/response.ts` which has `ok<T>()` (`{data}` envelope), `fail()` (`{error:{code,message,details}}` + ZodError/ApiError mapping) and `withApiErrors()`. hazy-note has none of that:

- Success: bare JSON body/array, **no `{data}` envelope**. Status 200, or explicit 201 on POST-create (`items`, `notes`, `projects`).
- Not found: `NextResponse.json({ error: "not found" }, { status: 404 })`.
- Bad input: `NextResponse.json({ error: "<message>" }, { status: 400 })` — free-text, no code.
- Delete: `NextResponse.json({ ok }, { status: ok ? 200 : 404 })`.
- Error shape is `{ error: string }` everywhere (vs hazy's nested object).
- **No `try/catch` in any handler.** The only `.catch()` is `req.json().catch(() => ({}))`. An unexpected throw from `repo.ts` / the LLM / the DB propagates to Next's default 500. `requireAppUser`'s `Unauthenticated` throw is never converted to a 401.
- Client side: `lib/api.ts` `j()` throws a generic `Error("<status> <statusText>")`; callers mostly `.catch(() => {})` or `.catch(() => setNotFound(true))`.

---

## 6. Clerk

`apps/hazy-note/middleware.ts`:

```ts
import { clerkMiddleware, createRouteMatcher } from "@clerk/nextjs/server";
const isPublicRoute = createRouteMatcher(["/sign-in(.*)", "/sign-up(.*)"]);
export default clerkMiddleware(async (auth, req) => {
  if (!isPublicRoute(req)) { await auth.protect(); }
});
export const config = {
  matcher: [
    "/((?!_next|[^?]*\\.(?:html?|css|js(?!on)|jpe?g|webp|png|gif|svg|ttf|woff2?|ico|csv|docx?|xlsx?|zip|webmanifest)).*)",
    "/(api|trpc)(.*)",
  ],
};
```

Only `/sign-in*` and `/sign-up*` are public; **everything else including all of `/api/*` requires a session** (`auth.protect()`). No per-route matcher granularity — it is all-or-nothing.

`auth()` usage: only in `lib/db/current-user.ts` — `const { userId: clerkId } = await auth()` plus `currentUser()` to populate `email` / `displayName` / `avatarUrl` when first creating the internal user row. `@clerk/nextjs`'s `<ClerkProvider>` wraps `app/layout.tsx`. Auth pages: `app/sign-in/[[...sign-in]]/page.tsx`, `app/sign-up/[[...sign-up]]/page.tsx`. Clerk env vars listed in `.dev.vars.example` (`NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `CLERK_SECRET_KEY`, sign-in/up URLs + force-redirect to `/notes`). README states hazy and hazy-note **share the same Clerk instance and the same `users` table**.

---

## 7. Cloudflare setup

**`apps/hazy-note/wrangler.jsonc`:**
```jsonc
{
  "main": ".open-next/worker.js",
  "name": "hazy-note",
  "compatibility_date": "2026-08-14",
```

### `src/lib/api/response.ts` (full)
```ts
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { ZodError } from "zod";
import { ApiError } from "./errors";

export function ok<T>(data: T, init?: { status?: number }) {
  return NextResponse.json({ data }, { status: init?.status ?? 200 });
}

export function fail(error: unknown) {
  if (error instanceof ApiError) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: { code: error.code, message: error.message, details: error.details } },
      { status: error.status }
    );
  }
  if (error instanceof ZodError) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: { code: "validation_error", message: "Request validation failed.", details: error.flatten() } },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }
  console.error("Unhandled API error:", error);
  return NextResponse.json(
    { error: { code: "internal_error", message: "Something went wrong." } },
    { status: 500 }
  );
}

/** Wrap a Route Handler body so every thrown ApiError/ZodError maps to the shared envelope. */
export function withApiErrors<Args extends unknown[]>(handler: (...args: Args) => Promise<Response>) {
  return async (...args: Args): Promise<Response> => {
    try { return await handler(...args); }
    catch (error) { return fail(error); }
  };
}
```
Note: depends on `next/server` `NextResponse` — for a standalone Worker this becomes plain `Response.json()`.

input.prompt:
Design a detailed implementation plan for extracting hazy's backend into a standalone Cloudflare Worker API at `api.hz.nknighta.me`. Repo: `/home/nknighta/_varius/hazy-repo` (bun workspace Turborepo: `apps/hazy`, `apps/hazy-note`, `packages/db`).

## Decisions already made (do not revisit)
- **Scope: hazy backend only.** Port hazy's 19 `/api/v1/**` routes. hazy-note keeps its own `/api/*` for now.
- **Framework: Hono standalone Worker** → new `apps/api`. NOT Next/OpenNext.
- **Hard cutover**: delete hazy's route handlers; hazy frontend calls `api.hz.nknighta.me` with a Clerk bearer token + CORS. No proxy handlers.
- **Shared `packages/api-client`**: one typed client (injects Clerk token, base URL from env) + the DTO/contract types. hazy adopts now; hazy-note later.

## Verified facts from codebase exploration

### hazy API surface (all under `apps/hazy/src/app/api/v1/`)
19 route files, every one: `export const runtime = "nodejs"`, wraps body in `withApiErrors` (from `src/lib/api/response.ts`), calls `requireUser()` (from `src/lib/auth/current-user.ts`) except the webhook, validates with zod `.parse()`, returns `ok(data,{status})` → `{data:T}`. No streaming anywhere (Ask pipeline is synchronous OpenRouter tool-calling, returns one JSON `AskResponseDTO`). No CORS/OPTIONS handlers. Routes: `ask/`, `ask/threads/`, `ask/threads/[id]/`, `ask/threads/[id]/messages/`, `collections/`, `collections/[id]/`, `collections/[id]/items/`, `collections/[id]/items/[savedUrlId]/`, `collections/[id]/summarize/`, `items/`, `items/[id]/`, `items/[id]/refetch/`, `items/[id]/summarize/`, `me/`, `read-later/`, `read-later/[itemId]/`, `read-later/stats/`, `search/`, `webhooks/clerk/`.

### Shared infra (all under `apps/hazy/src/lib/`, Workers-compatible except Clerk bits)
- `api/response.ts` — `ok<T>()` (`{data}` via `NextResponse.json`), `fail()` (maps `ApiError`/`ZodError` → `{error:{code,message,details}}`), `withApiErrors()`. **`NextResponse` → plain `Response.json` for Hono.**
- `api/errors.ts` — `ApiError`, `ServiceNotConfiguredError` (503), `UnauthorizedError` (401), `NotFoundError` (404), `ValidationError` (400). Pure — moves as-is.
- `auth/current-user.ts` — `getOptionalUser()` / `requireUser()`. Uses `auth()` + `currentUser()` from `@clerk/nextjs/server` (Next-runtime-bound — **the main porting work**). Does a DB lookup of `users` by `clerkId` on every call + first-sight insert of `users` + `userPreferences` rows. `@clerk/backend@^3.16.13` already a hazy dependency.
- `env.ts` — zod schema, every secret `.optional()`, reads `process.env` directly at module load (no `getCloudflareContext`). Vars: `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_HAZY_NOTE_URL`, `DATABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `CLERK_SECRET_KEY`, `CLERK_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET`, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `OPENROUTER_MODEL_ID` (default `google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it:free`), `OPENROUTER_SITE_URL`, `OPENROUTER_APP_NAME`. Helpers `isDatabaseConfigured()`, `isClerkConfigured()`, `isClerkWebhookConfigured()`, `isOpenRouterConfigured()`, `getMissingCoreServices()`.
- `ai/*` — `openrouter.ts` (`createChatCompletion`, `askOpenRouter`; `openai` v7 SDK @ openrouter baseURL; non-streaming; 20s timeout, 1 retry), `ask-pipeline.ts` (`runAskPipeline`), `ask-tools.ts`, `collection-sources.ts`, `prompt-templates.ts` (pure), `summarize-item.ts`, `summarize-collection.ts`. All Workers-compatible, deps: `openai`, `@/db`, `drizzle-orm`.
- `read-later/*` — `bucketing.ts` (pure), `get-queue.ts` (Drizzle).
- `search/keyword-search.ts` — Postgres FTS (`ts_rank`, `plainto_tsquery`, `@@`) + ILIKE fallback. `search_vector` maintained by a DB trigger (out of band). Workers-compatible.
- `metadata/fetch-metadata.ts` — `fetchUrlMetadata()`, uses global `fetch` + `cheerio/slim` (explicitly chosen for Workers). `metadata/normalize-url.ts` — `parseAndNormalizeUrl()`, imports `@/lib/api/errors` (`ValidationError`).
- `serializers.ts` — `serializeSavedUrl()`, `serializeCollection()`. Pure mapping.
- `types/api.ts` — pure types: `SavedUrlDTO`, `PaginatedResponse<T>`, `CollectionDTO`, `AskCitationDTO`, `AskMessageDTO`, `AskThreadDTO`, `AskResponseDTO`. Header comment: contract for a future Flutter client.
- `src/db/index.ts` — `getDb()` wraps `@repo/db/client` `getDb(env.DATABASE_URL)`, throws `ServiceNotConfiguredError("database")`. `src/db/schema.ts` re-exports `@repo/db/schema`. `packages/db/src/client.ts` is dual-driver: `localhost`/`127.0.0.1`/`::1` → `postgres` (postgres.js TCP); else → `@neondatabase/serverless` neon-http (the Workers branch). Module-level singleton cache.

### hazy frontend consumption
Entirely via relative `fetch("/api/v1/...")` inside `@tanstack/react-query` hooks under `apps/hazy/src/hooks/` (7 files: `use-ask.ts`, `use-items.ts`, `use-item.ts`, `use-collections.ts`, `use-read-later.ts`, `use-me.ts`, `use-search.ts`). Each re-declares a local `ApiEnvelope<T>` + `unwrap()` helper, imports DTO types from `@/types/api`. Plus 1 stray inline `fetch(\`/api/v1/read-later/${id}\`,{method:"PATCH"})` in `src/components/item/item-detail-view.tsx`. `query-provider.tsx`: `staleTime 30_000`, `retry 1`. **No server component calls the API or the DB repo for data.** Only `src/app/[locale]/page.tsx` and `src/app/[locale]/(app)/layout.tsx` call `getOptionalUser()` to gate rendering (redirect / SetupRequired). No `"use server"` actions.

### Clerk
`src/middleware.ts` — `clerkMiddleware`, `/api/**` bypasses next-intl. No route protection in middleware (per-resource via `requireUser()`). `auth()` used only in `current-user.ts`. Webhook `webhooks/clerk/route.ts`: `runtime=nodejs`, verifies via `verifyWebhook(req)` from `@clerk/nextjs/webhooks` (svix, `CLERK_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET`), handles `user.created/updated/deleted` → upsert/delete `users` + `userPreferences`, returns bare `"OK"`.

### Cloudflare setup (existing, hazy)
`apps/hazy/wrangler.jsonc`: `compatibility_date "2026-08-14"`, `compatibility_flags ["nodejs_compat","global_fetch_strictly_public"]`. `apps/hazy/next.config.ts`: `serverExternalPackages` (prod only) `["zod","drizzle-zod","drizzle-orm"]`, force-includes `postgres/**` + `@neondatabase/serverless/**` in output tracing. Deps present: `@opennextjs/cloudflare`, `wrangler ^4.123`, `@clerk/backend ^3.16.13`, `openai ^7.4`, `cheerio ^1.2`, `zod ^4.4`, `drizzle-orm ^0.45`. Root `turbo.json` has `globalEnv` list + `cf:build/cf:deploy/cf:preview` tasks. No committed domain refs; hazy prod URL assumed `hz.nknighta.me`, hazy-note assumed a sibling subdomain. compat date implies `process.env` is auto-populated from Worker bindings.

## What I need from you

A step-by-step plan covering:

1. **`apps/api` layout** — Hono app structure (`src/index.ts` with CORS + error middleware + routers; `src/routes/*` one per resource group; `src/middleware/auth.ts`; where the moved `lib/*` goes). Which of hazy's `src/lib/*` modules move verbatim, which need edits (`api/response.ts` NextResponse→Response; `current-user.ts` Clerk rewrite; `env.ts` — keep reading `process.env`?).
2. **Clerk auth in the Worker** — `@clerk/backend` `authenticateRequest` middleware pattern, `authorizedParties`, resolving/creating the internal `users` row (port `getOptionalUser`'s first-sight insert), how the webhook verifies (svix directly vs `@clerk/backend`). 401 semantics.
3. **Route porting** — the mechanical pattern to convert `export const GET = withApiErrors(async (req) => {... requireUser() ... ok(data) })` into a Hono handler. Keep the `{data}`/`{error:{code,message}}` envelope and zod validation. Path param mapping (`[id]` → `:id`). Note the URL prefix: routes served at `/v1/**` on the API origin.
4. **`packages/api-client`** — package layout, `createHazyClient({ baseUrl, getToken })` shape, where DTO/contract types live (move `types/api.ts` here; `apps/api` imports them back for response typing — is that dependency direction OK, or use a 3rd `packages/api-contract`?), the `ApiClientError` class, how to expose it to react-query hooks (a `useHazyClient()` hook using `useAuth().getToken`).
5. **hazy frontend cutover** — rewrite the 7 hook files + 1 inline fetch to use `@repo/api-client`; delete `src/app/api/`, `src/lib/api/`, `src/lib/ai/`, `src/lib/read-later/`, `src/lib/search/`, `src/lib/metadata/`, `src/lib/serializers.ts`, `src/lib/auth/current-user.ts`, `src/types/api.ts`, `src/db/`; simplify `getOptionalUser` usage in the 2 server components to a Clerk-only `auth()` check (no DB); prune now-unused deps from `apps/hazy/package.json` (`@repo/db`, `drizzle-orm`, `@neondatabase/serverless`, `postgres`, `drizzle-zod`, `openai`, `cheerio`, maybe `zod`); simplify `middleware.ts` (`/api` branch dead); `next.config.ts` (drop `serverExternalPackages` + tracing hacks); add `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL`.
6. **Local dev + deploy** — recommend Hono on `@hono/node-server` (tsx watch, :8787) for the `turbo run dev` loop (native postgres.js TCP to the local PG, `process.env` from `.env`), `wrangler dev` for preview, `wrangler deploy` for prod. `apps/api/wrangler.jsonc` (`name "hazy-api"`, `nodejs_compat`, custom domain `api.hz.nknighta.me`), secrets via `wrangler secret` / `.dev.vars`, `vars` for non-secret. Wire `apps/api` into root `turbo.json` (`dev`, `deploy`, `preview`, `check-types`) + `globalEnv` (add `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL`, `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`). Flag: the `postgres.js` localhost branch under `wrangler dev` workerd (TCP via `cloudflare:sockets` — works or fall back to Neon dev branch).

# Plan: Extract hazy backend into a standalone Hono Worker at `api.hz.nknighta.me`

## Guiding principle

Move code, don't rewrite it. The `src/lib/*` modules are already Workers-compatible; the only real porting work is (a) Clerk (`current-user.ts` + webhook), (b) swapping `NextResponse` for `Response` in one file, and (c) turning 19 Next Route Handlers into Hono handlers, a mechanical transform. Keep the `@/*` path alias in `apps/api` so moved files keep their imports unchanged.

## Phase 0 — Scaffolding

### 0.1 `packages/api-contract` (pure types, zero runtime deps)

Recommended over both alternatives in the brief. `apps/api` needs the DTOs for response typing and `packages/api-client` needs them for its return types.
```ts
import type { SavedUrlDTO, PaginatedResponse, CollectionDTO, AskResponseDTO,
  AskThreadDTO } from "@repo/api-contract";

export class ApiClientError extends Error {
  constructor(readonly code: string, message: string, readonly status: number,
              readonly details?: unknown) { super(message); this.name = "ApiClientError"; }
}

export interface HazyClientConfig {
  baseUrl: string;                        // https://api.hz.nknighta.me
  getToken: () => Promise<string | null>; // Clerk session token
}

function createRequest(cfg: HazyClientConfig) {
  return async function request<T>(path: string, init?: {
    method?: string; body?: unknown;
    query?: Record<string, string | number | undefined>; signal?: AbortSignal;
  }): Promise<T> {
    const url = new URL(`/v1${path}`, cfg.baseUrl);
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(init?.query ?? {}))
      if (v !== undefined) url.searchParams.set(k, String(v));
    const token = await cfg.getToken();
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      method: init?.method ?? "GET",
      headers: {
        ...(init?.body !== undefined ? { "Content-Type": "application/json" } : {}),
        ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
      },
      body: init?.body !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(init.body) : undefined,
      signal: init?.signal,
    });
    const json = await res.json().catch(() => null) as
      | { data: T } | { error: { code: string; message: string; details?: unknown } } | null;
    if (json && "error" in json)
      throw new ApiClientError(json.error.code, json.error.message, res.status, json.error.details);
    if (!res.ok || !json || !("data" in json))
      throw new ApiClientError("internal_error", `Request failed (${res.status})`, res.status);
    return json.data;
  };
}

export function createHazyClient(cfg: HazyClientConfig) {
  const request = createRequest(cfg);
  return {
    items: {
      list: (q: { sort?: "newest" | "oldest"; cursor?: string; limit?: number }, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
        request<PaginatedResponse<SavedUrlDTO>>("/items", { query: q, signal }),
      save:   (url: string) => request<SavedUrlDTO>("/items", { method: "POST", body: { url } }),
      get:    (id: string, signal?: AbortSignal) => request<SavedUrlDTO>(`/items/${id}`, { signal }),
      update: (id: string, body: { summary?: string | null; title?: string | null; tags?: string[] }) =>
        request<SavedUrlDTO>(`/items/${id}`, { method: "PATCH", body }),
      remove:    (id: string) => request<{ id: string }>(`/items/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" }),
      refetch:   (id: string) => request<SavedUrlDTO>(`/items/${id}/refetch`, { method: "POST" }),
      summarize: (id: string) => request<SavedUrlDTO>(`/items/${id}/summarize`, { method: "POST" }),
    },
    collections: { /* list, create, get, update, remove, addItem, removeItem, summarize */ },
    ask: {
      ask:          (body) => request<AskResponseDTO>("/ask", { method: "POST", body }),
      threads:      () => request<AskThreadDTO[]>("/ask/threads"),
      thread:       (id) => request(`/ask/threads/${id}`),
      deleteThread: (id) => request<{ id: string }>(`/ask/threads/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" }),
      postMessage:  (id, body) => request<AskResponseDTO>(`/ask/threads/${id}/messages`, { method: "POST", body }),
    },
    readLater: {
      queue:  () => request("/read-later"),
      stats:  () => request("/read-later/stats"),
      update: (itemId, body) => request(`/read-later/${itemId}`, { method: "PATCH", body }),
    },
    search: (q: string, limit?: number, signal?: AbortSignal) =>
      request<{ query: string; items: SavedUrlDTO[] }>("/search", { query: { q, limit }, signal }),
    me: { get: () => request("/me"), update: (body) => request("/me", { method: "PATCH", body }) },
  };
}
export type HazyClient = ReturnType<typeof createHazyClient>;
```

```ts
export type Env = { Variables: { user: AppUser } };
```

## Phase 2 — Clerk auth in the Worker

### 2.1 `apps/api/src/lib/auth/current-user.ts` (rewrite — the core porting work)

```ts
import { createClerkClient } from "@clerk/backend";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getDb } from "@/db";
import { userPreferences, users } from "@/db/schema";
import { UnauthorizedError } from "@/lib/api/errors";
import { env, isClerkConfigured, isDatabaseConfigured } from "@/env";

export type AppUser = typeof users.$inferSelect;

const clerk = () => createClerkClient({
  secretKey: env.CLERK_SECRET_KEY,
  publishableKey: env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY,
});

/** Verify the request's bearer token -> Clerk userId (or null). */
export async function authenticate(req: Request): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!isClerkConfigured()) return null;
  const state = await clerk().authenticateRequest(req, {
    authorizedParties: [env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL, "http://localhost:3100"],
  });
  if (!state.isSignedIn) return null;
  return state.toAuth().userId ?? null;
}

/** Port of getOptionalUser: clerkId -> internal users row, first-sight insert
 *  of users + userPreferences. */
export async function resolveUser(clerkId: string): Promise<AppUser> {
  if (!isDatabaseConfigured()) throw new UnauthorizedError();
  const db = getDb();
  const existing = await db.query.users.findFirst({ where: eq(users.clerkId, clerkId) });
  if (existing) return existing;

  const cu = await clerk().users.getUser(clerkId).catch(() => null);
  const email = cu?.primaryEmailAddress?.emailAddress ?? null;
  const displayName =
    [cu?.firstName, cu?.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(" ") || cu?.username || null;

  const [created] = await db.insert(users)
    .values({ clerkId, email, displayName, avatarUrl: cu?.imageUrl ?? null })
    .onConflictDoNothing({ target: users.clerkId })
    .returning();
  const user = created ?? (await db.query.users.findFirst({ where: eq(users.clerkId, clerkId) }));
  if (!user) throw new UnauthorizedError("Could not resolve account. Try again.");

  await db.insert(userPreferences).values({ userId: user.id })
    .onConflictDoNothing({ target: userPreferences.userId });
  return user;
}
```

`authenticateRequest` handles the `Authorization: Bearer <session-jwt>` flow; `credentials:false` CORS means no cookies, so this is pure bearer. `authorizedParties` guards the token's `azp` claim against tokens minted for other origins.

### 2.2 `apps/api/src/middleware/auth.ts`

```ts
import { createMiddleware } from "hono/factory";
import type { Env } from "@/app";
import { UnauthorizedError } from "@/lib/api/errors";
import { authenticate, resolveUser } from "@/lib/auth/current-user";

export const authMiddleware = createMiddleware<Env>(async (c, next) => {
  const clerkId = await authenticate(c.req.raw);
  if (!clerkId) throw new UnauthorizedError(); // -> fail() -> 401 {error:{code:"unauthorized"}}
  c.set("user", await resolveUser(clerkId));
  await next();
});
```

Optional `requireUser(c)` helper (`return c.get("user")`) so the route port stays close to the original `const user = await requireUser()` line.

### 2.3 Webhook — `apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts`

Move `webhooks/clerk/route.ts` body, swap the verifier:

```ts
import { Hono } from "hono";
import { verifyWebhook, type WebhookEvent } from "@clerk/backend/webhooks";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getDb } from "@/db";
import { userPreferences, users } from "@/db/schema";
import { env, isClerkWebhookConfigured, isDatabaseConfigured } from "@/env";

export const webhooks = new Hono();

webhooks.post("/clerk", async (c) => {
  if (!isClerkWebhookConfigured() || !isDatabaseConfigured())
    return c.text("Webhook not configured", 503);
  let event: WebhookEvent;
  try {
    event = await verifyWebhook(c.req.raw, { signingSecret: env.CLERK_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Clerk webhook verification failed:", e);
    return c.text("Verification failed", 400);
  }
  // ...identical user.created / user.updated / user.deleted upsert & delete logic...
  return c.text("OK", 200);
});
```

`@clerk/backend/webhooks#verifyWebhook` is the framework-agnostic primitive that `@clerk/nextjs/webhooks#verifyWebhook` wraps; it takes a standard `Request` and needs `svix` (transitively present via `@clerk/backend`). It reads `svix-id` / `svix-timestamp` / `svix-signature` + raw body, all on `c.req.raw`.

### 2.4 401 semantics
- No / bad / expired / wrong-`azp` token → `authenticate()` returns `null` → `UnauthorizedError()` → `401 {error:{code:"unauthorized",message:"Sign in required."}}`.
- Valid token, DB down → 503/500 (unchanged).
- Webhook: never runs auth middleware; returns bare `text` like the original.

| `ask/threads/route.ts` | | `GET /threads` |

```ts
"use client";
import { useInfiniteQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useHazyClient } from "@repo/api-client/react";
import type { PaginatedResponse, SavedUrlDTO } from "@repo/api-client";

export function useItemsQuery(sort: "newest" | "oldest" = "newest") {
  const client = useHazyClient();
  return useInfiniteQuery({
    queryKey: ["items", sort],
    queryFn: ({ pageParam, signal }) => client.items.list({ sort, cursor: pageParam }, signal),
    initialPageParam: undefined as string | undefined,
    getNextPageParam: (last) => last.nextCursor ?? undefined,
  });
}
export function useSaveUrlMutation() {
  const client = useHazyClient();
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (url: string) => client.items.save(url),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["items"] });
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["read-later"] });
    },
  });
}
```

# Extract hazy's backend into a standalone Hono Worker at `api.hz.nknighta.me`

## Context

`apps/hazy` currently ships its backend as 19 Next.js Route Handlers under
`src/app/api/v1/**` that run inside the same OpenNext Cloudflare Worker as the web UI.
That backend is really the product's API — the DTOs in `src/types/api.ts` are explicitly
"the contract a future Flutter client is built against" — but today it can only be reached
same-origin, it's bundled with (and bloats) the web Worker, and hazy-note has its own
parallel `/api/*` layer over the same database.

Goal: stand up a dedicated JSON API service at `https://api.hz.nknighta.me`, a small
Hono Worker, and turn `apps/hazy` into a pure frontend that calls it cross-origin with a
Clerk bearer token. This is the first step toward one shared backend for the whole
product; hazy-note's migration is a deliberate follow-up, not part of this pass.

**Decisions (from the user):**
- Scope: **hazy backend only** (19 `/api/v1/**` routes). hazy-note keeps its `/api/*` for now.
- Runtime: **Hono standalone Worker** → new `apps/api`. No Next / OpenNext.
- **Hard cutover**: delete hazy's route handlers; the frontend calls the API directly
  (Clerk `Authorization: Bearer` + CORS). No transition proxies.
- **Shared `packages/api-client`**: one typed client (injects the Clerk token, base URL
  from env) + the wire-contract types. hazy adopts now; hazy-note adopts later.

**Guiding principle:** move code, don't rewrite it. hazy's `src/lib/*` is already
Workers-compatible. The only real porting work is (a) Clerk (`current-user.ts` + the
webhook verifier), (b) `NextResponse` → `Response` in one file, (c) a mechanical
transform of 19 Route Handlers into Hono handlers. Keep the `@/*` path alias in
`apps/api` so every moved file's imports resolve unchanged.

---

## New workspace layout

```
packages/api-client/          NEW — typed client + contract types
  src/
    types.ts    ← verbatim move of apps/hazy/src/types/api.ts  (+ ad-hoc DTOs added while porting)
    client.ts   ← createHazyClient({ baseUrl, getToken }); ApiClientError
    react.ts    ← useHazyClient()  (subpath "./react", "use client")
    index.ts    ← re-exports client + `export * from "./types"`
  package.json  ← exports ".", "./react", "./types" (types = zero runtime deps)

apps/api/                     NEW — the Hono Worker
  src/
    index.ts    ← Worker entry: export default createApp()
    server.ts   ← local dev: @hono/node-server on :8787
    app.ts      ← builds the Hono app (CORS, onError, routers) — shared by both entries
    env.ts      ← moved from apps/hazy/src/lib/env.ts
    middleware/ { auth.ts, error.ts }
    routes/     { items, collections, ask, read-later, search, me, webhooks }.ts
    lib/
      api/ { errors.ts (verbatim), response.ts (NextResponse→Response) }
      auth/current-user.ts   ← rewritten for @clerk/backend
      ai/*  read-later/*  search/*  metadata/*  serializers.ts   ← verbatim moves
    db/ { index.ts, schema.ts }   ← moved from apps/hazy/src/db
    types/api.ts   ← one line: export * from "@repo/api-client/types"
  wrangler.jsonc, .dev.vars.example, tsconfig.json (keeps `@/*` → `./src/*`)
```

Note on the types package: folding the contract types into `@repo/api-client/types`
(a zero-runtime subpath) keeps this to **one** new client-facing package as the user
chose. `apps/api` depends on `@repo/api-client` but imports only `/types` — no React /
Clerk peer deps reach the Worker. (Alternative if layering purity matters later: split a
`packages/api-contract`; not needed now.)

---

## Phase 0 — Scaffold the two packages

1. **`packages/api-client`** — `package.json` (`name "@repo/api-client"`, `type module`,
   `exports` for `.`, `./react`, `./types`; dep `@clerk/nextjs` + `react` as optional
   peers for the `./react` subpath only), `tsconfig.json` extends `tsconfig.base.json`.
2. `src/types.ts` = verbatim `apps/hazy/src/types/api.ts` (`SavedUrlDTO`,
   `PaginatedResponse<T>`, `CollectionDTO`, `AskCitationDTO`, `AskMessageDTO`,
   `AskThreadDTO`, `AskResponseDTO`). Add named response types for endpoints that have no
   DTO today (`MeDTO`, `UserPreferencesDTO`, `ReadLaterQueueDTO`, `ReadLaterStatsDTO`,
   `SearchResponseDTO`) as each route is ported in Phase 3.
3. `src/client.ts` — `createHazyClient({ baseUrl, getToken })` returning resource groups
   (`items`, `collections`, `ask`, `readLater`, `search`, `me`). Core `request<T>()`:
   builds `new URL('/v1'+path, baseUrl)`, sets `Authorization: Bearer <token>` when
   `getToken()` resolves, parses the `{data}` / `{error:{code,message,details}}` envelope,
   throws `ApiClientError(code, message, status, details)` on `error` or non-2xx.
4. `src/react.ts` — `"use client"`; `useHazyClient()` = `useMemo` over
   `createHazyClient({ baseUrl: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, getToken })` with
   `getToken` from `useAuth()` (`@clerk/nextjs`).
5. **`apps/api`** skeleton — `package.json` (deps: `hono`, `@clerk/backend`,
   `@repo/api-client` `workspace:*`, `@repo/db` `workspace:*`, `@neondatabase/serverless`,
   `drizzle-orm`, `postgres`, `openai`, `cheerio`, `zod`; devDeps: `@hono/node-server`,
   `tsx`, `wrangler`, `@cloudflare/workers-types`, `@types/node`, `typescript`,
   `@biomejs/biome`). Scripts: `dev` (`tsx watch --env-file=.dev.vars src/server.ts`),
   `preview` (`wrangler dev`), `deploy` (`wrangler deploy`), `check-types`, `lint`,
   `cf-typegen`.
6. `apps/api/tsconfig.json` — extends base, `paths: { "@/*": ["./src/*"] }`,
   `types: ["@cloudflare/workers-types", "node"]`.

# Extract hazy's backend into a standalone Hono Worker at `api.hz.nknighta.me`

## Context

`apps/hazy` currently ships its backend as 19 Next.js Route Handlers under
`src/app/api/v1/**` that run inside the same OpenNext Cloudflare Worker as the web UI.
That backend is really the product's API — the DTOs in `src/types/api.ts` are explicitly
"the contract a future Flutter client is built against" — but today it can only be reached
same-origin, it's bundled with (and bloats) the web Worker, and hazy-note has its own
parallel `/api/*` layer over the same database.

Goal: stand up a dedicated JSON API service at `https://api.hz.nknighta.me`, a small
Hono Worker, and turn `apps/hazy` into a pure frontend that calls it cross-origin with a
Clerk bearer token. This is the first step toward one shared backend for the whole
product; hazy-note's migration is a deliberate follow-up, not part of this pass.

**Decisions (from the user):**
- Scope: **hazy backend only** (19 `/api/v1/**` routes). hazy-note keeps its `/api/*` for now.
- Runtime: **Hono standalone Worker** → new `apps/api`. No Next / OpenNext.
- **Hard cutover**: delete hazy's route handlers; the frontend calls the API directly
  (Clerk `Authorization: Bearer` + CORS). No transition proxies.
- **Shared `packages/api-client`**: one typed client (injects the Clerk token, base URL
  from env) + the wire-contract types. hazy adopts now; hazy-note adopts later.

**Guiding principle:** move code, don't rewrite it. hazy's `src/lib/*` is already
Workers-compatible. The only real porting work is (a) Clerk (`current-user.ts` + the
webhook verifier), (b) `NextResponse` → `Response` in one file, (c) a mechanical
transform of 19 Route Handlers into Hono handlers. Keep the `@/*` path alias in
`apps/api` so every moved file's imports resolve unchanged.

---

## New workspace layout

```
packages/api-client/          NEW — typed client + contract types
  src/
    types.ts    ← verbatim move of apps/hazy/src/types/api.ts  (+ ad-hoc DTOs added while porting)
    client.ts   ← createHazyClient({ baseUrl, getToken }); ApiClientError
    react.ts    ← useHazyClient()  (subpath "./react", "use client")
    index.ts    ← re-exports client + `export * from "./types"`
  package.json  ← exports ".", "./react", "./types" (types = zero runtime deps)

apps/api/                     NEW — the Hono Worker
  src/
    index.ts    ← Worker entry: export default createApp()
    server.ts   ← local dev: @hono/node-server on :8787
    app.ts      ← builds the Hono app (CORS, onError, routers) — shared by both entries
    env.ts      ← moved from apps/hazy/src/lib/env.ts
    middleware/ { auth.ts, error.ts }
    routes/     { items, collections, ask, read-later, search, me, webhooks }.ts
    lib/
      api/ { errors.ts (verbatim), response.ts (NextResponse→Response) }
      auth/current-user.ts   ← rewritten for @clerk/backend
      ai/*  read-later/*  search/*  metadata/*  serializers.ts   ← verbatim moves
    db/ { index.ts, schema.ts }   ← moved from apps/hazy/src/db
    types/api.ts   ← one line: export * from "@repo/api-client/types"
  wrangler.jsonc, .dev.vars.example, tsconfig.json (keeps `@/*` → `./src/*`)
```

Note on the types package: folding the contract types into `@repo/api-client/types`
(a zero-runtime subpath) keeps this to **one** new client-facing package as the user
chose. `apps/api` depends on `@repo/api-client` but imports only `/types` — no React /
Clerk peer deps reach the Worker. (Alternative if layering purity matters later: split a
`packages/api-contract`; not needed now.)

---

## Phase 0 — Scaffold the two packages

1. **`packages/api-client`** — `package.json` (`name "@repo/api-client"`, `type module`,
   `exports` for `.`, `./react`, `./types`; dep `@clerk/nextjs` + `react` as optional
   peers for the `./react` subpath only), `tsconfig.json` extends `tsconfig.base.json`.

**Checkpoint:** `bun install` resolves the new workspaces; existing `turbo run check-types` still green.

## Phase 1 — Move `src/lib`, `src/db`, `env.ts` into `apps/api`

**Verbatim moves** (only `@/lib/env` → `@/env` rewrites needed):
`src/lib/api/errors.ts`, `src/lib/ai/*` (7 files), `src/lib/read-later/{bucketing,get-queue}.ts`,

# Extract hazy's backend into a standalone Hono Worker at `api.hz.nknighta.me`

## Context

`apps/hazy` currently ships its backend as 19 Next.js Route Handlers under
`src/app/api/v1/**` that run inside the same OpenNext Cloudflare Worker as the web UI.
That backend is really the product's API — the DTOs in `src/types/api.ts` are explicitly
"the contract a future Flutter client is built against" — but today it can only be reached
same-origin, it's bundled with (and bloats) the web Worker, and hazy-note has its own
parallel `/api/*` layer over the same database.

Goal: stand up a dedicated JSON API service at `https://api.hz.nknighta.me`, a small
Hono Worker, and turn `apps/hazy` into a pure frontend that calls it cross-origin with a
Clerk bearer token. This is the first step toward one shared backend for the whole
product; hazy-note's migration is a deliberate follow-up, not part of this pass.

**Decisions (from the user):**
- Scope: **hazy backend only** (19 `/api/v1/**` routes). hazy-note keeps its `/api/*` for now.
- Runtime: **Hono standalone Worker** → new `apps/api`. No Next / OpenNext.
- **Hard cutover**: delete hazy's route handlers; the frontend calls the API directly
  (Clerk `Authorization: Bearer` + CORS). No transition proxies.
- **Shared `packages/api-client`**: one typed client (injects the Clerk token, base URL
  from env) + the wire-contract types. hazy adopts now; hazy-note adopts later.

**Guiding principle:** move code, don't rewrite it. hazy's `src/lib/*` is already
Workers-compatible. The only real porting work is (a) Clerk (`current-user.ts` + the

- `authenticate(req): Promise<string | null>` — `clerk().authenticateRequest(req, {
  authorizedParties: [env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL, "http://localhost:3100"] })`; return
  `state.toAuth().userId` when `state.isSignedIn`, else `null`.
- `resolveUser(clerkId): Promise<AppUser>` — port of `getOptionalUser`'s body: look up
  `users` by `clerkId`; on miss, `clerk().users.getUser(clerkId)` for email/name/avatar,
  `insert(users)...onConflictDoNothing().returning()` (re-select on conflict), then ensure
  a `userPreferences` row (`onConflictDoNothing`).

**`apps/api/src/middleware/auth.ts`** — `createMiddleware<Env>` that calls
`authenticate(c.req.raw)`, throws `UnauthorizedError()` on `null` (→ `fail()` → 401
envelope), else `c.set("user", await resolveUser(clerkId))`. Routes read `c.get("user")`
in place of `const user = await requireUser()`.

**`apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts`** — move `webhooks/clerk/route.ts` logic; swap
`verifyWebhook` from `@clerk/nextjs/webhooks` for
`verifyWebhook(c.req.raw, { signingSecret: env.CLERK_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET })` from
`@clerk/backend/webhooks` (framework-agnostic, Web-Crypto/svix, runs on Workers). Keep the
503-when-unconfigured guard, the `user.created|updated|deleted` upsert/delete, and the
bare `text("OK")` response. Mounted **before** the auth middleware.

**401 semantics:** missing / bad / expired / wrong-`azp` token → 401
`{error:{code:"unauthorized",message:"Sign in required."}}`. Valid token + DB down →
503/500. Webhook never runs auth.

## Phase 3 — Port the 19 routes

**Mechanical transform per handler** (`src/app/api/v1/items/route.ts` is the canonical example):

| Next Route Handler | Hono |
|---|---|
| `export const GET = withApiErrors(async (req) => {…})` | `r.get("/", async (c) => {…})` |
| `{ params }: { params: Promise<{ id }> }` | `const id = c.req.param("id")` |
| `const user = await requireUser()` | `const user = c.get("user")` |
| `await req.json()` | `await c.req.json()` |
| `new URL(req.url).searchParams.get("x")` | `c.req.query("x")` |
| `schema.parse({...})` / `throw new NotFoundError(…)` / `return ok(data,{status})` | unchanged |
| `export const runtime = "nodejs"` | delete |
| file-scoped helpers (`normalizeTags`, `loadOwnedItem`, …) | copy verbatim into the router module |

No streaming anywhere (Ask is a synchronous OpenRouter tool-calling loop returning one
`AskResponseDTO`) — no special handling.

**Router mounts** (full path = `/v1` + mount + route):

| Router (mount) | Routes |
|---|---|

| `collections` (`/collections`) | `GET /`, `POST /`, `GET/PATCH/DELETE /:id`, `POST /:id/items`, `DELETE /:id/items/:savedUrlId`, `POST /:id/summarize` |
| `ask` (`/ask`) | `POST /`, `GET /threads`, `GET/DELETE /threads/:id`, `POST /threads/:id/messages` |
| `readLater` (`/read-later`) | `GET /`, `GET /stats`, `PATCH /:itemId` |
| `search` (`/search`) | `GET /` |
| `me` (`/me`) | `GET /`, `PATCH /` |
| `webhooks` (`/webhooks`, no auth) | `POST /clerk` |

`ask/threads/[id]/messages` rethrows a "Thread not found" `Error` as `ValidationError` —
copy that try/catch verbatim. As each route lands, fill in the matching
`@repo/api-client` method and its request/response types (add missing ones to
`src/types.ts`).

**`apps/api/src/app.ts`** wires it: `hono/cors` on `/v1/*` → `app.onError(errorHandler)`

questions.question: Quillエディタで「@でURLを引用」機能はどうする?

options.label: Quillで作り直す（推奨）
options.description: @入力で保存済みURLの予測リストを出し、選ぶとリンク挿入＋notes.sourcesに出典登録。今の挙動をQuillのカスタムmoduleで再現。

options.label: 一旦なくす
options.description: エディタをQuillに置き換えるのみ。引用はリンクを手貼り。sourcesパネルは残すが自動登録はしない。あとで追加。

questions.question: 本文インラインのAI提案（採る/消す）は?

options.label: 右サイドバーに移動（推奨）
options.description: Quillは連続した本文なのでインラインブロックが合わない。提案は右パネルに一覧表示し「本文に採る」でカーソル位置に挿入。repo.tsのacceptSuggestion/dismissSuggestionを提案リスト方式に変更。

options.label: この対応では削除
options.description: suggestion関連（ブロック種別・API・repo関数）を撤去。現状ほぼ未使用。エディタ移行に集中。

options.label: 現状維持を試みる
options.description: 提案だけ従来のブロック表示をエディタ外（本文の下）に残す。二重管理になり複雑。

questions.question: ツールバーの見せ方は?

options.label: バブル（選択時に浮遊）推奨
options.description: テキスト選択で上にツールバーが出るQuillの bubble テーマ。今の「枠線なし・クリックで書く」ミニマルな見た目に合う。

options.label: 固定ツールバー（snow）
options.description: エディタ上部に常設のツールバー。機能が見えて分かりやすいが、Nocturneの静かなデザインとは少しぶつかる。

questions.question: 本文データの保存形式は?

options.label: notes.blocksを流用（推奨）
options.description: Quill Delta（opsの配列）をそのまま既存のjsonb列 notes.blocks に保存。DBマイグレーション不要。旧NoteBlock[]のノートは開いた時にDeltaへ自動変換して次回保存。

# @repo/db

The one Drizzle schema + client for the whole repo. `apps/hazy` and
`apps/hazy-note` are two views of the same product — same Clerk tenant, same
database — so there is a single schema here, not one per app.

## Layout

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `src/schema.ts` | Every table, enum and relation. The read-later core (`users`, `saved_urls`, `collections`, `read_later_state`, `ask_*`) plus hazy-note's additions (`source_kind` / `note_status` enums; extra `saved_urls` / `collections` columns; `notes` / `compare_boards` / `graph_snapshots`). |
| `src/client.ts` | `getDb(url?)` — lazy, self-caching. Picks **postgres.js** (TCP) for a `localhost` / `127.0.0.1` URL and **Neon's HTTP driver** for anything else. The HTTP branch is what lets both apps run on Cloudflare Workers, which has no raw TCP sockets. |
| `src/connection-options.ts` | `isLocalDatabaseUrl`, `resolveSslMode`. |
| `migrations/` | drizzle-kit migrations `0000`–`0004` + `meta/`. |
| `sql/search-vector-trigger.sql` | Keeps `saved_urls.search_vector` populated (drizzle-kit can't express a trigger). |

Consumed as `@repo/db` / `@repo/db/schema` / `@repo/db/client`. It's a JIT
package (exports `.ts`) — each app's bundler compiles it, no build step.

## How the apps use it

- **hazy** — `apps/hazy/src/db/index.ts` wraps `getDb` with hazy's "boot with no
  keys" check; `apps/hazy/src/db/schema.ts` re-exports `@repo/db/schema` so the
  ~20 `@/db/schema` imports keep working.
- **hazy-note** — `apps/hazy-note/lib/db/index.ts` is `export const db = getDb()`.
  `repo.ts` / `current-user.ts` / `seed.ts` query it directly.

Both resolve the signed-in Clerk user to a `users` row by `clerk_id`; same Clerk
instance → same `users.id` → `saved_urls` / `collections` are shared. A URL saved
in hazy shows up in hazy-note's library and vice versa.

**Change the schema once, here.** There is no second file to keep in sync.

## Scripts (run from `packages/db/`)

`DATABASE_URL` comes from `packages/db/.env.local` (gitignored — the Next apps
use their own `apps/*/.env.local`). Point it at whichever database you're
migrating.
