# hazy-note: replace the note editor with a Quill.js rich-text editor

## Context

hazy-note's note editor (`apps/hazy-note/app/(app)/notes/[id]/note-client.tsx`, ~550
lines) is a hand-rolled **block** editor: a `NoteBlock[]` array stored in `notes.blocks`
(jsonb), click-a-paragraph-to-edit `<textarea>`s, a custom `CiteBox`
(`components/cite-box.tsx`) for `@`-mention citations that insert `[title](url)` markdown,
a `RichText` component that re-parses those links, and inline `suggestion` blocks with
accept/dismiss. There is **no real formatting** (bold, headings, lists), the click-to-edit
flow is fiddly, and the block model complicates every consumer (`repo.ts`, `lib/ai.ts`,
the notes list, export).

Replace the editing surface with **Quill 2** (bubble theme) for genuine rich text, storing
the document as a Quill **Delta** in a new `notes.body` jsonb column. Legacy `blocks` notes
convert to a Delta the first time they're opened.

### Decisions (from the user)

- **`@`引用**: reimplement as a Quill module — typing `@` opens the saved-URL picker,
  picking one inserts a link and registers the source in `notes.sources`.
- **AI提案 (inline suggestions)**: move out of the body into the **right sidebar**; a
  `notes.suggestions` list with reworked accept ("本文に採る" → insert at cursor) / dismiss.
- **Toolbar**: Quill **bubble** theme (floating toolbar on text selection), styled to the
  Nocturne tokens.
- **Storage**: a **new `notes.body` jsonb column** holding the Delta `ops` array.
  `notes.blocks` stays as read-only legacy data, converted on first open.

Note: `suggestion` is currently **dead plumbing** — nothing generates suggestion blocks
(confirmed: no producer in `lib/ai.ts` / `repo.ts` / `seed.ts`). We keep the accept/dismiss
API and move the UI to the sidebar; legacy `suggestion` blocks migrate into the new column.

---

## New dependency

`quill@^2.0.3` in `apps/hazy-note/package.json` (client-only, ~55 KB gzip). **No**
`react-quill` (unmaintained for React 19). **No** `quill-mention` — hand-roll a small
mention module reusing the trigger-regex + caret math already in
`components/cite-box.tsx` (`TRIGGER = /(?:^|\s)@([^\s@[\]]*)$/`, the `pick()` offset math)
and its `onCite` integration.

---

## Schema — `packages/db/src/schema.ts`

Add to the `notes` table:

```ts
body: jsonb("body").$type<DeltaOp[]>().notNull().default([]),
suggestions: jsonb("suggestions")
  .$type<{ id: string; kind: string; text: string; ref?: string }[]>()
  .notNull()
  .default([]),
```

Define `DeltaOp` in a new `packages/db/src/delta.ts`
(`{ insert?: string | Record<string, unknown>; attributes?: Record<string, unknown>;
retain?: number; delete?: number }`) and export it from `src/index.ts`.

Then from `packages/db/`: `bun db:generate` → one additive `migrations/0005_*.sql`
(two `ADD COLUMN ... DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb`, **no drops**); `bun db:push` against local
(`127.0.0.1:5433`) and Neon.

---

## New files (`apps/hazy-note`)

### `lib/note-delta.ts` — pure helpers (safe in `repo.ts` server code and the client)

- `isDelta(v): v is DeltaOp[]`
- `legacyBlocksToDelta(blocks: unknown[]): { body: DeltaOp[]; suggestions: NoteSuggestion[] }`
  — `p` → paragraph (parse `[t](u)` markdown → `{ insert: t, attributes: { link: u } }`),
  `quote` → blockquote, `highlight` → text with `{ background }` attr, `suggestion` →
  pulled out into `suggestions[]` (generate an `id`).
- `deltaToPlainText(ops): string`
- `deltaToMarkdown(ops): string` — only the formats the toolbar enables
  (bold, italic, `header` 2/3, `blockquote`, `list` bullet/ordered, `link`).
- `deltaExcerpt(ops, max): string` — notes-list preview.
- `paragraphCount(ops): number`.

### `components/note-editor.tsx` — `"use client"` Quill wrapper

- `useRef<HTMLDivElement>` + `useEffect(() => { const q = new Quill(el, {...}); ... }, [])`
  (`new Quill` must run in the effect, never at module scope).
- Options: `theme: "bubble"`, `placeholder`, `modules.toolbar = [["bold","italic"],
  [{ header: 2 }, { header: 3 }], ["blockquote","link"],
  [{ list: "bullet" }, { list: "ordered" }]]`, plus the custom mention module.
- Props: `value: DeltaOp[]`, `onChange(ops)` (debounced ~700 ms off `text-change`),
  `onCite(t: CiteTarget)`, `placeholder`. Expose an imperative
  `insertTextAtCursor(text)` via `useImperativeHandle` for the sidebar "本文に採る".
- Round-trip: `q.setContents({ ops: value })` on mount / external change;
  `q.getContents().ops` in `onChange`. Guard the mount-time `setContents` so it doesn't
  fire `onChange`.
- **Mention module** (registered once, module-scope `Quill.register`): on `text-change` /
  `selection-change`, read the text before the cursor, match `TRIGGER`; if matched show a
  dropdown (reuse the `cite-box` dropdown markup/classes) of `api.items()` results
  (`it.kind !== "note"`); on pick, `q.deleteText(atIndex, queryLen)` +
  `q.insertText(atIndex, title, { link: url })` + `q.insertText(..., " ")`, then
  `onCite({ title, site, url })`.
- CSS: `import "quill/dist/quill.bubble.css"` + Nocturne overrides (see **CSS** below).

---

## Rewrites (`apps/hazy-note`)

### `app/(app)/notes/[id]/note-client.tsx`
Replace the `note.blocks.map(<Block/>)` + `<CiteBox>` region with
`<NoteEditor ref={editorRef} value={note.body} onChange={saveBody} onCite={cite} />`.
- Delete `Block`, `RichText`, `DeleteHandle`, `editBlockText`, `deleteBlock`,
  `addParagraph`, the `draft` state, the `showInline` toggle.
- Keep the `mutate` / `enqueue` write-chain. `saveBody(ops)` → `mutate({ body: ops })`.
  `mutate`'s payload gains `body` + `suggestions`, drops `blocks`.
- New right-sidebar `Panel` **"AIの提案"** listing `note.suggestions`:
  "本文に採る" → `editorRef.current.insertTextAtCursor(s.text)` then `act(s.id, "accept")`;
  "消す" → `act(s.id, "dismiss")`. `act` takes a suggestion `id` (was an index).
- Keep title / tags / status / rename / delete / export controls and the
  出典 / 状態 / つながるノート panels unchanged.

### `lib/types.ts`
- `Note.body: DeltaOp[]`, `Note.suggestions: NoteSuggestion[]`.
- Drop `blocks` from `Note` (the converter takes `unknown[]`). Keep the `NoteBlock` union
  (only `legacyBlocksToDelta` references it now).
- `NoteSuggestion = { id: string; kind: string; text: string; ref?: string }`.

### `lib/db/repo.ts`
- `toNote(row)` — `body: isDelta(row.body) && row.body.length ? row.body :
  legacyBlocksToDelta(row.blocks).body`; same pattern for `suggestions`. Lazy convert;
  the next `updateNote` persists it.
- `createNote` / `updateNote` — accept + write `body` and `suggestions`; remove `blocks`
  from the write path.
- `appendParagraph(text)` — append `{ insert: "\n" }, { insert: text }` to `body`
  (still used by `/api/notes/[id]` PATCH `{text}` and the compare→note flow).
- `acceptSuggestion(userId, noteId, id)` / `dismissSuggestion(userId, noteId, id)` —
  filter `suggestions` by `id`; drop the old `blocks[i] = { type: "p" }` mutation and the
  flag-stripping (or keep the flag-strip on accept).
- `buildGraph` search text (~line 774) — `deltaToPlainText(n.body)`.
- `buildExport` (~line 845) — pass `deltaToMarkdown(note.body)` to `rewriteForExport`.

### `lib/ai.ts` — `rewriteForExport`
Signature `{ title: string; markdown: string; format: ExportFormat }` (was
`{ title; blocks: NoteBlock[] }`). `plain` = `input.markdown`; `passthrough.blocks` =
split `markdown` on blank lines into `{ type: "p", text }`, stripping leading `#`/`>`;
drop `hasDraft` / the "未確定" warning (suggestions are no longer in the body).

### `app/(app)/notes/page.tsx`
Preview `deltaExcerpt(n.body, 140)`; meta `${paragraphCount(n.body)}段落 · ${n.sources.length}出典`.

### API routes + client
- `app/api/notes/route.ts`, `app/api/notes/[id]/route.ts` — parse `body` (array) and
  `suggestions`; keep the `{text}` append branch.
- `app/api/notes/[id]/suggestion/route.ts` — body `{ id: string, action }` (was
  `{ blockIndex, action }`).
- `lib/api.ts` — `addNote` / `updateNote` input types gain `body?` / `suggestions?`;
  `suggestion(id, suggestionId, action)`.

### Delete
`components/cite-box.tsx` (only imported by `note-client.tsx`).

---

## CSS — `app/globals.css` (`@layer components`) or `components/note-editor.css`

Quill's bubble theme ships light-mode CSS; override for Nocturne:
- `.ql-editor` — `font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.85; color: var(--color-text); padding: 0`;
  `p { margin: 0 0 15px }`; `h2/h3`, `blockquote` (left border `--color-accent`, bg
  `--color-surface`, radius `--radius-lg`), `ul/ol` spacing, `a` (`--color-accent`,
  underline `--color-accent`/40).
- `.ql-editor.ql-blank::before` — `color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text) 32%, transparent)`.
- `.ql-bubble .ql-tooltip` — `background: var(--color-neutral-900)`; arrow
  `border-*-color: var(--color-neutral-900)`; `box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--color-neutral-800),
  0 14px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.5)`.
- `.ql-bubble .ql-toolbar button .ql-stroke { stroke: color-mix(... text 60% ...) }`,
  `.ql-fill { fill: ... }`; `.ql-active .ql-stroke/.ql-fill → var(--color-accent)`.
- Mention dropdown — reuse the current `cite-box` dropdown classes verbatim.

If Turbopack rejects `import "quill/dist/quill.bubble.css"`, inline the ~40 needed rules
into `globals.css` instead.

---

## Reused, not rewritten

- `components/cite-box.tsx` — the `@` trigger regex, the caret/offset math in `pick()`,
  the dropdown markup and keyboard nav are ported into the Quill mention module.
- `lib/api.ts` `api.items()` — the saved-URL source for the mention picker.
- `note-client.tsx` `mutate` / `enqueue` serialized write-chain — kept as-is; `body`
  slots into the existing payload.
- `note-client.tsx` `cite()` — unchanged (still appends to `note.sources`).
- The sidebar panels (出典 / 状態 / つながるノート) and all note-header controls — untouched.

## Not changed

- `app/(app)/export/export-client.tsx` — `draftToMarkdown` operates on `ExportDraft.blocks`
  (the AI-output shape `{type:"p"|"h4"|"note"}`), not note blocks. Untouched; the 出典 list
  still reads `note.sources`.
- `notes.blocks` column — left in place (legacy read only). A follow-up migration drops it
  once every row has a `body`.
- `apps/hazy` — does not touch `notes`; unaffected. `apps/api` — unaffected.

---

## Verification

1. `packages/db`: `bun db:generate` → one additive `0005` migration (2 columns, no drops);
   `bun db:push` to local + Neon.
2. `bun run check-types` and `bun run lint` (repo-wide; hazy-note must be clean).
3. `bun run dev --filter=hazy-note` (:3000), sign in.
4. **Legacy note** (existing `blocks` data): opens as formatted text via
   `legacyBlocksToDelta`; edit → autosaves to `body`; reload → served from `body`
   (no re-conversion).
5. **`/notes/new`**: type; select text → bubble toolbar (bold / H2 / quote / list / link);
   no DB row until first edit; URL swaps to `/notes/:id` in place (focus kept).
6. **`@`引用**: `@` → dropdown of saved URLs → pick → link inserted (opens new tab on
   click) and the source appears in the 出典 panel.
7. **AI提案 panel**: seed a `suggestions` row (or open a legacy note that had a
   `suggestion` block) → "本文に採る" inserts at the cursor; "消す" removes it.
8. **`/export?noteId=…`**: draft still generates (via `deltaToMarkdown`); 出典 list intact.
9. **`/notes`** list: preview text + `N段落 · M出典` render from `body`.
10. **`/graph`**, **`/compare`**: build without error (repo helpers now use
    `deltaToPlainText`).

## Risks

- Quill bubble CSS specificity vs Tailwind v4 — may need a scoped wrapper class or a few
  `!important`s on `.ql-*` rules.
- Quill 2 + Turbopack CSS import — if `quill/dist/quill.bubble.css` fails to resolve,
  inline the rules (fallback noted above).
- `deltaToMarkdown` fidelity — scope strictly to the enabled formats; don't handle colors
  / nested lists / fonts (not offered by the toolbar).
- Store the Delta as the bare `ops` **array** (`DeltaOp[]`), not the `{ ops }` wrapper —
  `q.setContents({ ops })`, read back `q.getContents().ops`.

accept/dismiss. There is **no real formatting** (bold, headings, lists), the click-to-edit
flow is fiddly, and the block model complicates every consumer (`repo.ts`, `lib/ai.ts`,
the notes list, export).

Replace the editing surface with **Quill 2** (bubble theme) for genuine rich text, storing
the document as a Quill **Delta** in a new `notes.body` jsonb column. Legacy `blocks` notes
convert to a Delta the first time they're opened.

Quillエディタの実装が完了しました。**check-types / lint / `next build`（hazy-note全ルート）すべてグリーン**、delta変換ヘルパーも単体テスト済み。3サーバー稼働中（api:8787 / hazy:3100 / hazy-note:3000）。

## 実装内容

| ファイル | 変更 |
|---|---|
| `packages/db/src/{delta.ts,schema.ts,index.ts}` | `DeltaOp`型、`notes.body`（Delta）+ `notes.suggestions` 列、マイグレーション `0005`（**ローカルDBは適用済み**） |
| `apps/hazy-note/components/note-editor.tsx` | **新規** — Quill 2 bubbleテーマ。`quill`は`useEffect`内で動的import（SSR回避）。`@`入力で保存済みURLのドロップダウン→リンク挿入＋`onCite`。600msデバウンス保存。`insertTextAtCursor`をrefで公開 |
| `apps/hazy-note/lib/note-delta.ts` | **新規** — `deltaToPlainText` / `deltaToMarkdown`（ツールバー対応フォーマットのみ）/ `deltaExcerpt` / `paragraphCount` / `legacyBlocksToDelta`（旧`blocks`→Delta、`[t](u)`→リンク、`suggestion`→サイドバー行） |
| `note-client.tsx` | ブロック編集UIを`<NoteEditor>`に置換。AI提案を右サイドバー「AIの提案」パネルへ（本文に採る＝カーソル挿入、消す）。`Block`/`RichText`/`DeleteHandle`削除 |
| `repo.ts` | `toNote`が旧`blocks`を遅延変換（次回保存で`body`に永続化）。`createNote`/`updateNote`/`appendParagraph`/`accept・dismissSuggestion`（id指定に変更）/`buildGraph`/`buildExport` |
| `lib/ai.ts` | `rewriteForExport`が`markdown`文字列を受け取る |
| API routes + `lib/api.ts` | `body`/`suggestions`パース、`suggestion(id, suggestionId, action)` |
| `notes/page.tsx` | プレビューを`deltaExcerpt`/`paragraphCount`に |
| `globals.css` | Quill bubbleテーマのNocturne配色オーバーライド |
| `components/cite-box.tsx` | 削除 |

## 残り

1. **ブラウザ動作確認** — 認証が要るのでCLIからは不可。既存ノート（旧`blocks`）が整形テキストで開くか、`@`引用、選択でバブルツールバー、AI提案パネルなど
2. **Neonへ `0005` 適用** — `packages/db/.env.local` の Neon URL をコメント解除して `bun db:push`、または `psql "<neon>" -f packages/db/migrations/0005_useful_jack_flag.sql`
3. **コミット**（未実施）

feat(hazy-note): Quill rich-text note editor

Replace the hand-rolled block editor (click-to-edit textareas, a custom
CiteBox, inline suggestion blocks) with Quill 2 (bubble theme). The note
body is now a Quill Delta stored in the new notes.body column; notes that
predate this convert from the legacy `blocks` column on read and persist
to `body` on the next save.

- components/note-editor.tsx: Quill wrapper — dynamic-imported so it never
  touches `document` during SSR, bubble toolbar (bold/italic, H2/H3,
  blockquote, link, bullet/ordered list), 600ms-debounced onChange, and an
  imperative insertTextAtCursor. Typing `@` pops the saved-URL picker
  (ported from the old CiteBox); a pick inserts a link and registers the
  source via onCite.
- lib/note-delta.ts: deltaToPlainText / deltaToMarkdown (limited to the
  toolbar's formats) / deltaExcerpt / paragraphCount / legacyBlocksToDelta
  (p → paragraph incl. [t](u) links, quote → blockquote, highlight →
  background, suggestion → pulled into the sidebar list).
- AI suggestions move from inline body blocks to a right-sidebar "AIの提案"
  panel; accept inserts at the cursor, both accept and dismiss filter the
  notes.suggestions list by id (repo + /suggestion route + lib/api).
- repo.ts: toNote lazy-converts; createNote/updateNote/appendParagraph
  write `body`/`suggestions`; buildGraph and buildExport read the body via
  the delta helpers. lib/ai.ts rewriteForExport now takes Markdown text.
- notes list preview + counts derive from the Delta; globals.css gets the
  Quill bubble-theme overrides for the Nocturne palette; cite-box.tsx
  removed.

Migration 0005 (notes.body + notes.suggestions) is additive; applied to
the local DB, still pending on Neon. check-types, lint and `next build`
for hazy-note all pass.

---root README---
# @repo/db

The one Drizzle schema + client for the whole repo. `apps/hazy` and
`apps/hazy-note` are two views of the same product — same Clerk tenant, same
database — so there is a single schema here, not one per app.

## Layout

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `src/schema.ts` | Every table, enum and relation. The read-later core (`users`, `saved_urls`, `collections`, `read_later_state`, `ask_*`) plus hazy-note's additions (`source_kind` / `note_status` enums; extra `saved_urls` / `collections` columns; `notes` / `compare_boards` / `graph_snapshots`). |
| `src/client.ts` | `getDb(url?)` — lazy, self-caching. Picks **postgres.js** (TCP) for a `localhost` / `127.0.0.1` URL and **Neon's HTTP driver** for anything else. The HTTP branch is what lets both apps run on Cloudflare Workers, which has no raw TCP sockets. |
| `src/connection-options.ts` | `isLocalDatabaseUrl`, `resolveSslMode`. |
| `migrations/` | drizzle-kit migrations `0000`–`0004` + `meta/`. |
| `sql/search-vector-trigger.sql` | Keeps `saved_urls.search_vector` populated (drizzle-kit can't express a trigger). |

Consumed as `@repo/db` / `@repo/db/schema` / `@repo/db/client`. It's a JIT
package (exports `.ts`) — each app's bundler compiles it, no build step.

## How the apps use it

- **hazy** — `apps/hazy/src/db/index.ts` wraps `getDb` with hazy's "boot with no
  keys" check; `apps/hazy/src/db/schema.ts` re-exports `@repo/db/schema` so the
  ~20 `@/db/schema` imports keep working.
- **hazy-note** — `apps/hazy-note/lib/db/index.ts` is `export const db = getDb()`.
  `repo.ts` / `current-user.ts` / `seed.ts` query it directly.

Both resolve the signed-in Clerk user to a `users` row by `clerk_id`; same Clerk
instance → same `users.id` → `saved_urls` / `collections` are shared. A URL saved
in hazy shows up in hazy-note's library and vice versa.

**Change the schema once, here.** There is no second file to keep in sync.

## Scripts (run from `packages/db/`)

`DATABASE_URL` comes from `packages/db/.env.local` (gitignored — the Next apps
use their own `apps/*/.env.local`). Point it at whichever database you're
migrating.

| Command | What |
|---|---|
| `bun db:generate` | Diff `schema.ts` against the migration snapshots → new SQL. |
| `bun db:migrate` | Apply pending migrations (tracked in `drizzle.__drizzle_migrations`). |
| `bun db:push` | Push the schema straight to the DB (no migration file). |
| `bun db:trigger` | (Re-)apply `sql/search-vector-trigger.sql`. |
| `bun db:studio` | Drizzle Studio. |

### First migrate against a database hazy already `db:push`-ed

`0000_baseline` recreates the tables hazy made by hand, so on such a database it
must be skipped while `0001`+ still run:

```bash
psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f scripts/register-baseline.sql   # once
bun db:migrate
```

drizzle decides what to run by comparing `created_at` (ms); the script seeds a
row for `0000` (`1787944616065`) so only later migrations apply.

### Rollback (hazy-note additions are all additive)

```sql
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS graph_snapshots, compare_boards, notes CASCADE;
ALTER TABLE saved_urls
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS kind, DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS points,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS suggested_tags, DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS duration_label,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS quote_candidates, DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS related_note_id,
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS summary_lines;
ALTER TABLE collections DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS tone;
DROP TYPE IF EXISTS note_status;
DROP TYPE IF EXISTS source_kind;
DELETE FROM drizzle."__drizzle_migrations" WHERE created_at > 1787944616065;
```

`users` / `saved_urls` / `collections` data is untouched.

# hazy

Turborepo for **hazy** and **hazy-note** — two views of one product, one Clerk
tenant, one database, one API.

| | |
|---|---|
| `apps/hazy` | Save URLs, search your reading, ask questions about it, read-later digest. Pure frontend (Next 16, Turbopack, next-intl en/ja) — talks to `apps/api`. |
| `apps/hazy-note` | Turn saved URLs into your own writing: capture → organise → notes (Quill editor) → compare → graph → export. Next 16. Still has its own `/api/*` route handlers. |
| `apps/api` | The hazy backend — a **Hono Worker** for `api.hz.nknighta.me`. Serves hazy's `/v1/**` JSON API + the Clerk webhook. See `apps/api/README.md`. |
| `packages/api-client` | `@repo/api-client` — the typed client (`createHazyClient` / `useHazyClient`) + the wire-contract DTO types, shared by hazy and any future native client. |
| `packages/db` | `@repo/db` — the single Drizzle schema + client + migrations + search-vector trigger. See `packages/db/README.md`. |

Both apps resolve the signed-in Clerk user to a `users` row by `clerk_id`; same
Clerk instance → same `users.id` → `saved_urls` / `collections` are shared. A URL
saved in hazy shows up in hazy-note's library and vice versa.

## Getting started

```bash
bun install
# packages/db/.env.local + apps/*/.env.local + apps/api/.dev.vars
#   — DATABASE_URL, Clerk, OpenRouter
bun run dev     # turbo: api on :8787, hazy-note on :3000, hazy on :3100
```

hazy dev needs `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8787` in `apps/hazy/.env.local`.

Local Postgres for development: `apps/hazy-note/scripts/localdb.sh start`
(user-owned PG on `127.0.0.1:5433`, no Docker). Then, from `packages/db/`:
`bun db:push && bun db:trigger`.

## Tasks (`bun run <task>` at the root → `turbo run`)

| Task | |
|---|---|
| `dev` | All dev servers (`--filter=<app>` for one). api runs on `@hono/node-server`; hazy / hazy-note on `next dev --turbopack` |
| `build` | `next build --turbopack` for the Next apps |
| `lint` | Biome |
| `check-types` | `tsc --noEmit` across every package |
| `deploy` / `preview` | `apps/api` — `wrangler deploy` / `wrangler dev` |
| `cf:build` / `cf:deploy` / `cf:preview` | `apps/hazy` / `apps/hazy-note` — OpenNext → Cloudflare Workers |
| `db:generate` / `db:migrate` / `db:push` / `db:trigger` / `db:studio` | `@repo/db`, driven by `packages/db/.env.local` |

## Deploy

Three independent Cloudflare Workers:

- **`apps/api`** — a plain Hono Worker (`wrangler.jsonc`, no OpenNext). Custom
  domain `api.hz.nknighta.me`. `bun run deploy --filter=api`, then
  `wrangler secret put …` from `apps/api/` for `DATABASE_URL`, `CLERK_SECRET_KEY`,
  `CLERK_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`,
  `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`. Point the Clerk dashboard webhook at
  `https://api.hz.nknighta.me/v1/webhooks/clerk`.
- **`apps/hazy`** / **`apps/hazy-note`** — OpenNext (`open-next.config.ts`).
  `bun run cf:deploy --filter=<app>`. hazy needs
  `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.hz.nknighta.me` as a Worker var.

`apps/api` and hazy-note reach the database over `@repo/db`'s Neon HTTP driver
(Workers has no raw TCP). Locally, a `127.0.0.1` `DATABASE_URL` transparently
switches to the postgres.js TCP driver instead; `apps/api` dev also runs on Node
(not workerd) so that path just works.

# api

hazy's backend as a standalone service — a small **Hono** Worker for
`https://api.hz.nknighta.me`. Extracted from `apps/hazy`'s old
`/api/v1/**` route handlers; hazy is now a pure frontend that calls this
over CORS with a Clerk bearer token.

## Surface

Everything under `/v1`, `{ data }` on success / `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`
on failure:

| Group | Routes |
|---|---|
| `items` | `GET /`, `POST /`, `GET/PATCH/DELETE /:id`, `POST /:id/refetch`, `POST /:id/summarize` |
| `collections` | `GET /`, `POST /`, `GET/PATCH/DELETE /:id`, `POST /:id/items`, `DELETE /:id/items/:savedUrlId`, `POST /:id/summarize` |
| `ask` | `POST /`, `GET /threads`, `GET/DELETE /threads/:id`, `POST /threads/:id/messages` |
| `read-later` | `GET /`, `GET /stats`, `PATCH /:itemId` |
| `search` | `GET /` |
| `me` | `GET /`, `PATCH /` |
| `webhooks` | `POST /clerk` — Svix-verified, no auth middleware |

`GET /health` is unauthenticated. The DTO shapes are the contract in
`@repo/api-client` (`packages/api-client/src/types.ts`).

## Layout

```
src/
  index.ts        Worker entry — export default createApp()
  server.ts       local dev — @hono/node-server on :8787
  app.ts          the Hono app: CORS, onError, routers
  env.ts          zod-validated process.env (from wrangler vars/secrets)
  middleware/auth.ts   Clerk bearer -> internal users row on c.get("user")
  routes/*        one Hono sub-app per group
  lib/            ai/, search/, metadata/, read-later/, serializers.ts,
                  api/{errors,response}.ts, auth/current-user.ts — moved
                  from apps/hazy, Workers-safe as-is
  db/             getDb() (@repo/db) + schema re-export
```

`@/*` resolves to `./src/*`, so the moved `lib/*` files keep their imports.

## Dev / deploy

```bash
bun run dev --filter=api      # tsx watch, real Node, :8787, reads .dev.vars
bun run preview --filter=api  # wrangler dev (workerd) — point .dev.vars DATABASE_URL at a Neon branch
bun run deploy --filter=api   # wrangler deploy
```

Node dev uses the postgres.js TCP driver for a `127.0.0.1` `DATABASE_URL`;
production (and `wrangler dev`) uses `@repo/db`'s Neon HTTP driver.

`.dev.vars` (gitignored, copy `.dev.vars.example`) feeds both `tsx --env-file`
and `wrangler dev`. Production secrets:

```bash
cd apps/api
wrangler secret put DATABASE_URL
wrangler secret put CLERK_SECRET_KEY
wrangler secret put CLERK_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET
wrangler secret put NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
wrangler secret put OPENROUTER_API_KEY
```

Non-secret config (`OPENROUTER_MODEL_ID`, `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`, …) is in
`wrangler.jsonc` `vars`. After deploy, set the Clerk dashboard webhook endpoint
to `https://api.hz.nknighta.me/v1/webhooks/clerk`.

## Notes

- `compatibility_flags: ["nodejs_compat", "global_fetch_strictly_public"]` — the
  second is the SSRF guard for `fetchUrlMetadata`'s outbound requests.
- `search` assumes `saved_urls.search_vector` is maintained by the DB trigger
  (`packages/db/sql/search-vector-trigger.sql`, applied out of band).

# hazy

Save URLs, search your reading, ask questions about it, catch up on a
read-later digest. Next 16 (App Router, Turbopack, React Compiler) +
next-intl (en / ja) + Tailwind + shadcn/radix.

**hazy is a pure frontend.** The backend lives in `apps/api`
(`api.hz.nknighta.me`); every data call goes through `@repo/api-client`
(`useHazyClient()` in the react-query hooks under `src/hooks/`). This app
only needs Clerk (for `<ClerkProvider>` + the server-side redirect gate in
`src/app/[locale]/(app)/layout.tsx`) and `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL`.

## Dev

```bash
bun run dev --filter=hazy   # :3100 — needs apps/api on :8787
```

`apps/hazy/.env.local`:

```
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8787
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3100
NEXT_PUBLIC_HAZY_NOTE_URL=http://localhost:3000
NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=...
CLERK_SECRET_KEY=...
```

## Deploy

OpenNext → Cloudflare Workers (`wrangler.jsonc`, `open-next.config.ts`).
`bun run cf:deploy --filter=hazy`. Set `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.hz.nknighta.me`
as a Worker var. The cross-origin API call carries a Clerk session token as
`Authorization: Bearer`; `apps/api`'s CORS allowlist must include this app's
origin (`CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`).

## Structure

- `src/hooks/use-*.ts` — react-query wrappers over `@repo/api-client`.
- `src/app/[locale]/**` — pages; only the two layout/gate files touch Clerk
  server-side, nothing reads the DB.
- `src/lib/env.ts` — the four `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` vars + the two Clerk keys.
- `src/middleware.ts` — Clerk context + next-intl locale routing.

# hazy-repo

Turborepo, bun workspaces. One product, one Clerk tenant, one database, one API.

| Package | What |
|---|---|
| `apps/api` | `hazy-api` — a **Hono Worker** at `api.hz.nknighta.me`. hazy's backend: `/v1/**` JSON API + the Clerk webhook. |
| `apps/hazy` | `hz.nknighta.me` — a **pure frontend** (Next 16, Turbopack). No backend, no DB. Calls `apps/api` via `@repo/api-client`. |
| `apps/hazy-note` | `note.hz.nknighta.me` — Next 16. Capture → notes (Quill editor) → compare → graph → export. **Still has its own `/api/*` route handlers** over `@repo/db` (migrating to `apps/api` is a follow-up). |
| `packages/api-client` | `@repo/api-client` — typed client (`createHazyClient` / `useHazyClient`) + the wire-contract DTO types. The single source of truth for the API shape. |
| `packages/db` | `@repo/db` — the one Drizzle schema + `getDb()` + migrations + search-vector trigger. |

## Rules

- **Package manager: `bun`.** `bun install` at the root, `bun add <pkg> --filter <app>`,
  `bun run <task>` (→ `turbo run`, `--filter=<name>` to scope). One `bun.lock` at the root.
- **Schema changes go in `packages/db/src/schema.ts` only.** Then `bun db:generate`
  (from `packages/db/`) + apply. There is no per-app schema.
- `apps/hazy` must never regain a `src/db` or `src/app/api` — data flows
  frontend → `@repo/api-client` → `apps/api`. Add API methods to
  `packages/api-client/src/client.ts` and the DTO to `src/types.ts`.
- Three Workers, three custom domains, deployed independently. See each app's
  README for the deploy + `wrangler secret put` steps. `apps/api` also needs the
  Clerk dashboard webhook pointed at `api.hz.nknighta.me/v1/webhooks/clerk`.
- `bun run dev` starts all three: api :8787 (Node, `@hono/node-server`),
  hazy-note :3000, hazy :3100. hazy needs `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8787`.

## Database

`getDb()` picks the driver from the URL: postgres.js (TCP) for
`localhost` / `127.0.0.1`, Neon's HTTP driver otherwise (Workers has no raw TCP).
Local dev DB: `apps/hazy-note/scripts/localdb.sh` (user-owned PG 18 on
`127.0.0.1:5433`). The Neon database is the production one — all three apps share it.

# api

hazy's backend — a **Hono Worker** (`hazy-api`) for `api.hz.nknighta.me`.
Extracted from `apps/hazy`'s old `/api/v1/**` route handlers. See `README.md`
for the route surface.

# Layout

- `@/*` → `./src/*` (tsconfig paths). The `lib/*` files moved verbatim from
  `apps/hazy/src/lib` keep their imports because of this.
- `src/app.ts` builds the Hono app (CORS, `onError`, routers). `src/index.ts` is
  the Worker entry; `src/server.ts` is local dev on `@hono/node-server`.
- `src/routes/*` — one Hono sub-app per group. Ported route handlers: `c.get("user")`
  for the auth'd user, `c.req.param()/.query()/.json()`, `zod .parse()` (caught by
  `onError`), `return ok(data, { status })`.
- `src/middleware/auth.ts` — `@clerk/backend` verifies the `Authorization: Bearer`
  token, resolves/creates the internal `users` row.
- `src/lib/api/response.ts` — `ok()` / `fail()`, plain `Response.json` (not
  `NextResponse`). Envelope: `{ data }` / `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`.

# Rules

- **Contract types live in `@repo/api-client`** (`packages/api-client/src/types.ts`),
  re-exported here as `@/types/api`. Add a DTO there, add the client method in
  `packages/api-client/src/client.ts`, then the route here.
- DB via `getDb()` (`@/db` → `@repo/db`). Schema changes → `packages/db` only.
- Runtime = workerd (prod) / Node (dev). `process.env` is populated from
  `wrangler.jsonc` vars + `wrangler secret`. Keep the `lib/*` code Workers-safe
  (no `fs`, no `node:*` beyond what's already there).

  `bun run deploy --filter=api` = `wrangler deploy`. Secrets: `wrangler secret put`

`bun`. `bun add <pkg> --filter api`. One `bun.lock` at the repo root.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Copy the Neon (production) database into the local dev DB — for working
# against real data. Data only: both databases must already be on the same
# schema (run the migrations first). The local DB is TRUNCATEd.
#
#   NEON_DATABASE_URL='postgresql://…neon.tech/neondb?sslmode=require' \
#     scripts/sync-from-neon.sh [-y]
#
# NEON_DATABASE_URL   required (or a `…neon.tech…` line in packages/db/.env.local)
# LOCAL_DATABASE_URL  default postgresql://hazy@127.0.0.1:5433/hazy
# -y                  skip the confirmation prompt
set -euo pipefail

PGBIN="${PGBIN:-/usr/lib/postgresql/18/bin}"
LOCAL_DATABASE_URL="${LOCAL_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://hazy@127.0.0.1:5433/hazy}"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../../.." && pwd)"

# --- resolve the Neon URL ---
NEON_URL="${NEON_DATABASE_URL:-}"
if [ -z "$NEON_URL" ] && [ -f "$REPO_ROOT/packages/db/.env.local" ]; then
  NEON_URL="$(grep -oE 'postgres(ql)?://[^ ]*neon\.tech[^ ]*' "$REPO_ROOT/packages/db/.env.local" | head -1 || true)"
fi
if [ -z "$NEON_URL" ]; then
  echo "error: set NEON_DATABASE_URL (or add a neon.tech line to packages/db/.env.local)" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# --- guard: never truncate a non-local database ---
case "$LOCAL_DATABASE_URL" in
  *@127.0.0.1[:/]*|*@localhost[:/]*|*@::1[]:/]*) ;;
  *) echo "error: LOCAL_DATABASE_URL doesn't look local — refusing to truncate it: $LOCAL_DATABASE_URL" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

PSQL="$PGBIN/psql"
PG_DUMP="$PGBIN/pg_dump"
[ -x "$PSQL" ] || { PSQL=psql; PG_DUMP=pg_dump; }

count() { "$PSQL" "$1" -tAqc "$2" 2>/dev/null || echo "?"; }

echo "  from : ${NEON_URL%%\?*}  ($(count "$NEON_URL" "select count(*) from saved_urls") saved_urls)"
echo "  into : $LOCAL_DATABASE_URL  ($(count "$LOCAL_DATABASE_URL" "select count(*) from saved_urls") saved_urls — will be replaced)"

if [ "${1:-}" != "-y" ]; then
  read -r -p "TRUNCATE the local DB and load Neon's data? [y/N] " ans
  [ "$ans" = "y" ] || [ "$ans" = "Y" ] || { echo "aborted"; exit 1; }
fi

DUMP="$(mktemp -t hazy-neon-XXXXXX.sql)"
trap 'rm -f "$DUMP"' EXIT

echo "· dumping Neon (data only)…"
"$PG_DUMP" "$NEON_URL" --data-only --schema=public --disable-triggers \
  --no-owner --no-privileges --no-comments -f "$DUMP"

echo "· truncating local…"
"$PSQL" "$LOCAL_DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -qc "
  DO \$\$
  DECLARE t text;
  BEGIN
    SELECT string_agg(format('%I.%I', schemaname, tablename), ', ')
      INTO t FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public';
    IF t IS NOT NULL THEN EXECUTE 'TRUNCATE ' || t || ' RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE'; END IF;
  END \$\$;"

echo "· loading…"
"$PSQL" "$LOCAL_DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -f "$DUMP"

echo "· done. row counts (local / Neon):"
for tbl in users saved_urls collections collection_items read_later_state \
           ask_threads ask_messages ask_message_citations notes; do
  printf '  %-22s %s / %s\n' "$tbl" \
    "$(count "$LOCAL_DATABASE_URL" "select count(*) from $tbl")" \
    "$(count "$NEON_URL" "select count(*) from $tbl")"
done

content.text:
受信箱アイテムのクリック挙動を修正しました（`7427f87` push 済み）。

**原因:** カードのリンク先 `/capture?id=…` は開くたびに `finishReading`（取得＋抽出＋AI要約）を無条件で再実行していました。

**修正:** 新しい詳細ページ `/library/[id]` に遷移 — **開いてもAIは走りません**。

| 要素 | |
|---|---|
| 表示 | タイトル・出典・URL・要約行・抽出した論点・引用候補数・タグ・置き場所 |
| 未要約のアイテム | 「要約する」ボタン（明示的に `finishReading`）|
| 要約済み | 「要約し直す」ボタン |
| 置き場所 | select で即プロジェクト移動（`updateItem`）|
| その他 | 「ノートを開く/作る」、「取り込みを開き直す」（`/capture?id=` ウィザード）、削除 |

`library-client.tsx` のカードタイトルのリンクを `/library/${id}` に変更。新規URL追加直後（`ingest`）や「Hazyから追加」「ここにドロップ」は従来どおり `/capture` ウィザードのまま。

check-types / lint OK。ブラウザ（:3000）で確認を。
